questions.question:
Taxonomy has traditionally been based on morphology. DNA barcoding is a new approach that aims to allow accurate and relatively simple species identification based on the nucleotide sequence of a 650-bp fragment of the mitochondrial COI gene. The Kimura 2-parameter (K2P) distance is a widely accepted index that reflects the divergence between two DNA sequences.

In a study on fish inhabiting the Persian Gulf, over 150 individuals were studied that, based on morphology, represented 83 species. The average of intraspecific K2P distances based on COI sequence was calculated to be 1.15%. The average distance reported in various reputable fish studies in the world has been 0.25%–0.45%.

In a study on fish inhabiting the Gulf of Mexico, again over 150 individuals were studied. Based on morphology, these fish represented 76 species, 56 genera, 32 families, 11 orders, and 2 classes. The table below presents K2P distances between specimens at different taxonomic levels.
questions.question_zh:
传统分类学以形态为基础。DNA 条形码是一项新方法，旨在依据线粒体 COI 基因中一段 650 bp 片段的核苷酸序列，实现准确且相对简单的物种鉴定。Kimura 双参数（K2P）距离是广泛接受的指标，用于反映两条 DNA 序列之间的分化程度。

在一项针对波斯湾鱼类的研究中，共研究了 150 多个个体；依据形态，它们代表 83 个物种。基于 COI 序列计算的种内 K2P 距离平均为 1.15%。而世界范围内多项权威鱼类研究报告的平均距离为 0.25%–0.45%。

在另一项针对墨西哥湾鱼类的研究中，同样研究了 150 多个个体。依据形态，这些鱼代表 76 个物种、56 个属、32 个科、11 个目和 2 个纲。下表给出不同分类阶元内标本之间的 K2P 距离。

subQuestions.text: The evolutionary rate of sequence change in a DNA fragment chosen for DNA barcoding should certainly be more rapid than the evolutionary rate of change in the H4 histone encoding gene.

subQuestions.label: B

subQuestions.label: C

subQuestions.text_zh: 表中的数据支持“可以基于 COI 片段序列进行鱼类物种鉴定”这一主张。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: Table 1 suggests that COI based barcoding is not appropriate for genus identification.
subQuestions.text_zh: 表 1 提示，基于 COI 的条形码不适合用于属级鉴定。

questions.explanation:
A【对】DNA 条形码要求种内变异小、种间变异大，因此所选片段必须比高度保守的 H4 组蛋白基因积累更多变异，进化速率更快。
B【对】若名义种内存在隐存种或高度分化的类群，种内平均 K2P 会被拉高；这正好解释波斯湾研究 1.15% 远高于全球其它研究 0.25%–0.45% 的现象。
C【对】表中种内最大距离为 1.66%，而属内最小距离为 6.19%，两者之间存在明显的条形码间隙，支持用 COI 鉴定物种。
D【对】属内距离范围（6.19%–20.23%）与科内距离（10.88%–24.56%）大幅重叠，说明 COI 难以稳定区分属级单元，因此不适合单独用于属级鉴定。

questions.question:
Taxonomy has traditionally been based on morphology. DNA barcoding is a new approach that aims to allow accurate and relatively simple species identification based on the nucleotide sequence of a 650-bp fragment of the mitochondrial COI gene. The Kimura 2-parameter (K2P) distance is a widely accepted index that reflects the divergence between two DNA sequences.

Selected results relating to 16 species from five barcoding studies from different regions of the world are presented below. Three types of divergence values were calculated: global, intraregional, and interregional distances. Global divergence, which is commonly used, was the average of all pairwise comparisons of sequences belonging to the same species regardless of location of origin. Intraregional divergences were calculated by averaging the distances of all sequences belonging to the same species from the same location. Finally, interregional distances were calculated by averaging all distance values obtained from comparing each of the sequences from one location with all sequences of the same species in a second location.

Results of three calculations (i, ii, and iii) are given below:

i. The average standard deviation (SD) of 17 intraregional comparisons pertaining to 10 species was 0.11% (minimum: 0%; maximum: 0.3%). The SD of divergences of an 18th intraregional comparison pertaining to one of these species was 1.26%.

ii. The intraregional divergence of Argyrops spinifer specimens from India was 0.20%, and the interregional divergence of specimens from India and South Africa was 0.13%.

iii. Global divergence for Platycephalus indicus was 9.46%. Interregional divergences for this species were as follows: India/China 15.78%, China/Australia 12.05%, India/Australia 10.61%, China/S Africa 16.05%, India/S Africa 4.05%, Australia/S Africa 10.95%.
questions.question_zh:
传统分类学以形态为基础。DNA 条形码是一项新方法，旨在依据线粒体 COI 基因中一段 650 bp 片段的核苷酸序列，实现准确且相对简单的物种鉴定。Kimura 双参数（K2P）距离是广泛接受的指标，用于反映两条 DNA 序列之间的分化程度。

下面给出世界不同地区 5 项条形码研究中 16 个物种的部分结果。研究计算了三类分化值：全局距离、区域内距离和区域间距离。常用的全局分化是同一物种全部序列两两比较的平均值，不考虑来源地点。区域内分化是同一地点同一物种全部序列距离的平均值。区域间距离则是将一个地点的每条序列与另一地点同一物种的全部序列比较后所得距离的平均值。

三项计算（i、ii、iii）结果如下：

i. 涉及 10 个物种的 17 组区域内比较，其标准差（SD）平均为 0.11%（最小 0%，最大 0.3%）。其中某一物种的第 18 组区域内比较，其分化标准差为 1.26%。

ii. 来自印度的 Argyrops spinifer 标本的区域内分化为 0.20%，而印度与南非标本之间的区域间分化为 0.13%。

iii. Platycephalus indicus 的全局分化为 9.46%。该物种的区域间分化如下：印度/中国 15.78%，中国/澳大利亚 12.05%，印度/澳大利亚 10.61%，中国/南非 16.05%，印度/南非 4.05%，澳大利亚/南非 10.95%。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: The SD value of the 18th comparison in calculation (i) above is consistent with the suggestion that the fish compared in fact do not all belong to the same species.
subQuestions.text_zh: 上述计算 (i) 中第 18 组比较的 SD 值，与“所比较的鱼实际上并不都属于同一物种”这一看法相符。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: The K2P divergence values reported in calculation (ii) is consistent with the proposal that A. spinifer populations of India and South Africa arose from a common source population, but that there is greater variation in the ecological niches of India as compared to South Africa.
subQuestions.text_zh: 计算 (ii) 报道的 K2P 分化值与下列观点相符：印度和南非的 A. spinifer 种群来自共同的源种群，但印度的生态位变异比南非更大。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: The divergence values in calculation (iii) show that, as compared to interregional divergence values, global divergence values are more informative of extent of divergence that exists for P. indicus in the world.
subQuestions.text_zh: 计算 (iii) 的分化值表明，与区域间分化值相比，全局分化值更能反映 P. indicus 在世界范围内的分化程度。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: With reference to calculation (iii), the difference between global divergence value (9.46%) and average of interregional divergence values (11.58%) can be explained by unequal number of specimens from different regions.
subQuestions.text_zh: 就计算 (iii) 而言，全局分化值（9.46%）与区域间分化平均值（11.58%）之间的差异，可以用不同地区标本数量不等来解释。

questions.explanation:
A【对】17 组区域内比较的 SD 平均仅 0.11%，而第 18 组高达 1.26%，约高一个数量级，提示该组比较中混入了不同物种或高度分化的隐存种。
B【对】印度群体区域内分化（0.20%）高于印度—南非区域间分化（0.13%），说明印度群体内部更异质，与“共同来源、但印度生态位变异更大”的解释一致。
C【错】全局距离把所有地点、所有标本合并平均，会掩盖区域间的真实差异；对 P. indicus 而言，区域间距离在 4.05%–16.05% 之间大幅变化，比单一全局值（9.46%）更能反映各地群体的分化格局。
D【对】全局平均是把全部两两比较合并后求平均；若各地标本数不等，各地对总平均的权重不同，因此全局值 9.46% 与六个区域间值的简单平均 11.58% 不一致是正常的。

questions.question: Pulse-chase experiments performed in cells are experiments in which cells are first exposed to labelled precursors of specific molecules for a short period of time (the pulse), unincorporated labelled precursors are then washed away, and presence of label in molecules of interest are followed through time (the chase). In an experiment designed to study gene expression, cells were exposed to labelled UTP during the pulse, and results of the chase part of the experiment are summarized in the figure below.
questions.question_zh: 细胞中的脉冲—追踪实验，是先将细胞短时间暴露于特定分子的标记前体（脉冲），洗去未掺入的标记前体，然后随时间追踪标记在目标分子中的出现情况（追踪）。在一项研究基因表达的实验中，细胞在脉冲阶段暴露于标记的 UTP，追踪阶段的结果总结于下图。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: Based on the data presented, most (~90% of mass) of RNA that is synthesized in the nucleus is degraded in the nucleus without ever entering the cytoplasm.
subQuestions.text_zh: 根据所给数据，在细胞核中合成的 RNA 大部分（约 90% 的质量）在核内被降解，从未进入细胞质。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Based on data presented, the complexity of RNA (which refers to number of different sequences) in the nucleus is higher than in the cytoplasm.
subQuestions.text_zh: 根据所给数据，细胞核中 RNA 的复杂度（即不同序列的种类数）高于细胞质。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: Assuming that introns constitute 60% of primary transcripts, splicing can account for the observed difference in amount of label in the nucleus at start of chase and amount of label in the cytoplasm after eight hours of chase.
subQuestions.text_zh: 假设内含子占初级转录本的 60%，则剪接可以解释追踪开始时核内标记量与追踪 8 小时后胞质标记量之间的差异。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: It is expected that chases of longer than 8 hours would have ultimately shown a much higher amount of label in the cytoplasm than seen at 8 hours.
subQuestions.text_zh: 预计追踪时间长于 8 小时后，胞质中的标记量最终会远高于 8 小时时的水平。

questions.explanation:
A【对】追踪开始时核 RNA 标记为 100%，8 小时后降至接近 0；胞质标记仅升至约 9%，说明约 90% 的新合成 RNA 在核内被降解，未进入胞质。
B【错】图中只给出标记总量（质量），并未比较不同序列的种类数；不能由标记量推断核内 RNA 复杂度更高。
C【错】若内含子占 60%，剪接最多只能去掉 60%，胞质中应剩约 40%；实际胞质标记仅约 9%，说明除剪接外还有大量核内降解。
D【错】胞质标记在约 6–8 小时已趋于平台（约 9%），延长追踪不会出现远高于 8 小时的胞质标记量。

questions.question:
Enzyme activity usually correlates with its conformational flexibility, such that higher flexibility (lower rigidity) is usually accompanied with higher activity. Tryptophan residues which emit fluorescence are most commonly located within the nonpolar interior environment of proteins. An excellent way to experimentally determine the exposure of tryptophan residues to solution is by measuring the quenching (decrease) of their fluorescence. The effect of mutations on the accessibility of tryptophan residues can be studied by measuring the amount of fluorescence quenching by potassium iodide (KI). Iodide ions selectively quench fluorescence emitted by exposed tryptophan residues.

In the experiment whose results are presented below, fluorescence quenching of equal amounts of three mutated forms of an enzyme (mutant forms 1, 2, and 3) was measured after addition of various concentrations of KI (0–0.6 M). Excitation and emission wavelengths used were specific for tryptophan. Quenching data were analysed in terms of the Stern–Volmer constant, KSV, which can be calculated from the ratio of the unquenched and the quenched fluorescence intensities, F0/F, using the relationship F0/F = 1 + KSV[Q], where [Q] is the molar concentration of the quencher.
questions.question_zh:
酶的活性通常与其构象柔性相关：柔性越高（刚性越低），活性通常越高。发出荧光的色氨酸残基最常位于蛋白质的非极性内部环境中。实验测定色氨酸残基暴露于溶液程度的理想方法，是测量其荧光淬灭（荧光下降）的程度。通过测量碘化钾（KI）引起的荧光淬灭量，可以研究突变对色氨酸残基可及性的影响；碘离子会选择性地淬灭暴露的色氨酸残基所发出的荧光。

在下面给出的实验中，向等量的三种突变型酶（突变体 1、2、3）中加入不同浓度的 KI（0–0.6 M）后，测定荧光淬灭。激发与发射波长均为色氨酸特异。淬灭数据用 Stern–Volmer 常数 KSV 分析；KSV 可由未淬灭与淬灭后的荧光强度之比 F0/F 按关系式 F0/F = 1 + KSV[Q] 计算，其中 [Q] 为淬灭剂的摩尔浓度。

images.caption: Stern–Volmer plots of fluorescence quenching by KI for mutant forms 1, 2 and 3.
images.caption_zh: 突变体 1、2、3 的 KI 荧光淬灭 Stern–Volmer 图。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: Among the three mutated proteins, protein 1 is expected to have the lowest enzymatic activity.
subQuestions.text_zh: 在三种突变蛋白中，蛋白 1 的酶活性预计最低。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Iodide ions have higher accessibility to the tryptophan residues of protein 2 as compared to protein 3.
subQuestions.text_zh: 与蛋白 3 相比，碘离子对蛋白 2 色氨酸残基的可及性更高。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: Protein 3 has the highest KSV.
subQuestions.text_zh: 蛋白 3 的 KSV 最高。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: Protein 1 does not have tryptophan residues.
subQuestions.text_zh: 蛋白 1 不含色氨酸残基。

questions.explanation:
A【对】图中蛋白 1 的 Stern–Volmer 直线最平缓，KSV 最小，说明其色氨酸埋藏最深、构象最刚性；按“柔性越高活性越高”的关系，蛋白 1 的酶活性最低。
B【错】直线的斜率即 KSV，三者关系为 3 > 2 > 1；蛋白 2 的 KSV 小于蛋白 3，说明碘离子对蛋白 2 色氨酸的可及性更低。
C【对】蛋白 3 的直线最陡，斜率 KSV 最大，表明其色氨酸暴露程度最高。

questions.question:
MicroRNAs are short non-coding RNAs expressed in various tissues and cell types that suppress the expression of target genes. MicroRNAs involved in cancer are called oncomiRs. Inhibition of oncomiRs using antisense oligomers (that is, antimiRs) is an evolving therapeutic strategy. However, the in vivo efficacy of current antimiR technologies is hindered by physiological and cellular barriers for delivery into targeted cells.

A novel antimiR delivery platform that specifically targets the tumour microenvironment makes use of synthetic molecules called peptide nucleic acid (PNA) antimiRs attached to a peptide called pHLIP. PNA antimiRs are antimiRs whose nucleotides are connected by peptide bonds instead of the normal phosphodiester bonds. The structure of pHLIP is pH dependent. At low pH, a transmembrane structure is induced in pHLIP that facilitates transport of attached PNA into tumour cells (Fig. 1). pHLIP-mediated transport of antimiR-155 effectively inhibited the miR-155 oncomiR in cultured cells (Fig. 2).
questions.question_zh:
微小 RNA（miRNA）是在多种组织和细胞类型中表达的短非编码 RNA，可抑制靶基因表达。与癌症相关的 miRNA 称为癌 miRNA（oncomiR）。用反义寡聚体（即 antimiR）抑制 oncomiR 是一种正在发展的治疗策略。然而，现有 antimiR 技术进入靶细胞的体内效率受到生理与细胞屏障的限制。

一种新型 antimiR 递送平台可特异靶向肿瘤微环境，它利用一种称为肽核酸（PNA）antimiR 的合成分子，并将其连接到名为 pHLIP 的肽上。PNA antimiR 的核苷酸之间由肽键而非正常的磷酸二酯键连接。pHLIP 的结构依赖 pH：在低 pH 下，pHLIP 被诱导形成跨膜结构，促进所连接的 PNA 进入肿瘤细胞（图 1）。pHLIP 介导的 antimiR-155 转运在培养细胞中有效抑制了 miR-155 oncomiR（图 2）。

images.caption: Fig. 1: Targeting miR-155 in a mouse lymphoma model using PNA-antimiR-155-pHLIP. a: Distribution of pHLIP (yellow and red zones) 36 h after injection into the tail. b: Schematic presentation of pHLIP-mediated PNA antimiR delivery.
images.caption_zh: 图 1：在小鼠淋巴瘤模型中用 PNA-antimiR-155-pHLIP 靶向 miR-155。a：尾部注射 36 h 后 pHLIP 的分布（黄色与红色区域）。b：pHLIP 介导 PNA antimiR 递送的示意图。

images.caption: Fig. 2: pH-dependent transport and activity of PNA-antimiR-155-pHLIP. a: Microscopy images of A549 cells incubated with labelled PNA-antimiR-155-pHLIP (red fluorescence) at two pH values; the nucleus is labelled blue. b: Effects of pHLIP-antimiR-155 on cell viability at two different pH values.
images.caption_zh: 图 2：PNA-antimiR-155-pHLIP 的 pH 依赖性转运与活性。a：A549 细胞在两种 pH 下与标记的 PNA-antimiR-155-pHLIP（红色荧光）共孵育的显微图像；细胞核为蓝色。b：两种 pH 下 pHLIP-antimiR-155 对细胞活力的影响。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: Based on the data, you can conclude the liver does not function in clearing the pHLIP-antimiRs from the body.
subQuestions.text_zh: 根据这些数据可以得出结论：肝脏不参与清除体内的 pHLIP-antimiR。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: At pH less than 7, pHLIP inserts into the lipid bilayer and thus facilitates delivery of attached antimiR-155.
subQuestions.text_zh: 在 pH 小于 7 时，pHLIP 插入脂双层，从而促进所连接的 antimiR-155 的递送。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: The acidic microenvironment of tumours is responsible for intracellular release of antimiR-155.
subQuestions.text_zh: 肿瘤的酸性微环境负责 antimiR-155 在胞内的释放。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: The antimiR cargo will be trapped within endosomes.
subQuestions.text_zh: antimiR 货物将被滞留在内体中。

subQuestions.label: E
subQuestions.text: Transition from random coil to helix of pHLIP enhances cell death.
subQuestions.text_zh: pHLIP 从无规卷曲转变为螺旋会增强细胞死亡。

questions.explanation:
A【错】图 1a 显示尾部注射 36 h 后肝脏出现很强的 pHLIP 信号，说明肝脏参与摄取/清除，而不是不参与。
B【对】图 1b 与图 2a 表明：pH 6.2 时 pHLIP 由无规卷曲转变为跨膜螺旋并插入膜中，携带 antimiR-155 进入细胞（红色荧光明显）；pH 7.4 时进入很少。
C【错】酸性微环境的作用是触发 pHLIP 插膜和递送；antimiR 的胞内释放依赖胞内还原环境使二硫键断裂（生成 HS-antimiR），并非酸性本身。
D【错】图 1b 显示 antimiR 从 pHLIP 上释放到胞质并与 miR-155 结合，并未被滞留于内体。
E【对】图 2b 显示 pH 6.2 时 pHLIP-antimiR-155 显著降低细胞活力，说明螺旋化插膜递送增强了细胞死亡。

Primary and secondary response genes can be distinguished by ...

B【错】同时抑制转录会把初级反应和次级反应一起阻断，无法区分两者。

subQuestions.label: A

subQuestions.text_zh: 这些药物会降低体内糖类分解代谢。

subQuestions.text_zh: 这些药物会降低体温。

questions.explanation:

questions.question:
Some restriction enzymes have different recognition sequences but create the same sticky ends, as shown below for SalI and XhoI.

The following gel electrophoresis image shows linearized DNAs obtained after complete restriction enzyme digestion of non-recombinant (empty vector) and recombinant (containing gene X) expression plasmid vectors. The expression vector includes a strong promoter near its cloning site. The insert of the recombinant plasmid was a product of SalI digestion. The insert was ligated into the vector which had been cut with XhoI.

* All recombinant vectors gave the same pattern in the gel.
questions.question_zh:
有些限制酶识别序列不同，却产生相同的黏性末端，如下图所示 SalI 与 XhoI。

下面的凝胶电泳图显示空载体（非重组）和重组（含基因 X）表达质粒载体经限制酶完全酶切后得到的线性 DNA。该表达载体在克隆位点附近有一个强启动子。重组质粒的插入片段是 SalI 酶切的产物，插入到用 XhoI 切开的载体中。

* 所有重组载体在凝胶中给出相同的条带模式。

images.caption: SalI and XhoI recognition sequences produce compatible sticky ends.
images.caption_zh: SalI 与 XhoI 的识别序列产生相容的黏性末端。

images.caption: Gel electrophoresis of empty and recombinant vectors after SalI, XhoI, and SalI + XhoI digestion.
images.caption_zh: 空载体与重组载体经 SalI、XhoI 及 SalI + XhoI 酶切后的凝胶电泳。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: The data indicate that two copies of the insert were cloned in the expression vector.
subQuestions.text_zh: 数据表明表达载体中克隆了两个拷贝的插入片段。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Half of the clones are expected to be able to transcribe the mRNA of gene X.
subQuestions.text_zh: 预计有一半克隆能够转录基因 X 的 mRNA。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: An XhoI site exists outside of the insert in the recombinant vector of the experiment.
subQuestions.text_zh: 在该实验的重组载体中，插入片段之外存在一个 XhoI 位点。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: The 2 kb fragment seen in the gel can be used as probe to screen for the recombinant vectors.
subQuestions.text_zh: 凝胶中看到的 2 kb 片段可以用作探针来筛选重组载体。

subQuestions.label: E
subQuestions.text: If the insert produced by SalI digestion was ligated into a vector that had been cut with both XhoI and SalI enzymes and the recombinant plasmid subsequently cut with XhoI, a 4 kb product would be obtained.
subQuestions.text_zh: 若将 SalI 酶切产生的插入片段连接到同时用 XhoI 和 SalI 切开的载体中，随后再用 XhoI 切割重组质粒，将得到 4 kb 的产物。

questions.explanation:
A【错】空载体为 5 kb，重组载体为 7 kb，只增加了 2 kb，说明只插入了一个 2 kb 片段，而不是两个拷贝。
B【对】插入片段与载体连接有两种方向；只有与启动子同向的那一半克隆能转录基因 X 的 mRNA，因此约一半克隆可转录。
C【错】重组载体用 XhoI 单酶切只得到 7 kb 线性分子，说明只有一个 XhoI 位点；结合双酶切得到 5 kb + 2 kb，可判断该 XhoI 位点位于插入片段一侧的克隆位点内，而不是插入片段之外。
D【错】2 kb 片段是 XhoI 与 SalI 双酶切产物，包含载体与插入片段连接处及部分载体序列；用它作探针会同时与空载体杂交，不能特异筛选重组载体。
E【错】按题干构建方式，插入片段两端为 SalI/XhoI 兼容末端，连接后原有位点被破坏；XhoI 单酶切实验观察到的是 7 kb 线性分子，不会产生 4 kb 片段。

questions.question: Mating experiments with a yeast species that has 16 chromosomes of equal length were performed. Results of mating between two mutant yeast strains (shown with an unhappy phenotype), each with a mutation in a single gene, are shown below. The mutated allele of each gene is recessive with respect to the wild type allele. Unhappy is polygenic and many genes affect the phenotype. Recombination does not occur in these yeast strains.
questions.question_zh: 以一种具有 16 条等长染色体的酵母为材料进行交配实验。两个突变酵母菌株（表现为 unhappy 表型）各带有一个单基因突变，交配结果如下图所示。每个基因的突变等位基因相对于野生型等位基因均为隐性。Unhappy 为多基因性状，许多基因都可影响该表型。这些酵母菌株中不发生重组。

images.caption: Crosses between m1 and m2 haploids. Cross 1 (m1 × m1) and cross 2 (m2 × m2) yield all unhappy diploids and all unhappy meiosis products; cross 3 (m1 × m2) yields all happy diploids, and its meiosis products are unknown.
images.caption_zh: m1 与 m2 单倍体之间的交配。交配 1（m1 × m1）与交配 2（m2 × m2）得到全部 unhappy 的二倍体及全部 unhappy 的减数分裂产物；交配 3（m1 × m2）得到全部 happy 的二倍体，其减数分裂产物未知。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: If mutations of m1 and m2 were in the same gene, it is possible that all products of meiosis of cross 3 will be unhappy.
subQuestions.text_zh: 如果 m1 和 m2 的突变位于同一基因，交配 3 的减数分裂产物有可能全部为 unhappy。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: If 1 happy to 3 unhappy yeasts were produced from meiosis of cross 3, then the mutation of m1 and the mutation of m2 were in different genes.
subQuestions.text_zh: 如果交配 3 的减数分裂产生 1 个 happy 对 3 个 unhappy 的酵母，则 m1 的突变与 m2 的突变位于不同基因。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: If 1 happy to 1 unhappy yeasts were produced from meiosis of cross 3, then the mutation of m1 and the mutation of m2 can suppress each other.
subQuestions.text_zh: 如果交配 3 的减数分裂产生 1 个 happy 对 1 个 unhappy 的酵母，则 m1 的突变与 m2 的突变能够相互抑制。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: If the experiments were performed with various pairs of unhappy mutants, the most frequently observed ratio of happy to unhappy yeasts among meiosis products of cross 3 would be 1:3.
subQuestions.text_zh: 如果用各种不同的 unhappy 突变体配对进行实验，交配 3 的减数分裂产物中最常观察到的 happy 与 unhappy 比例将是 1:3。

questions.explanation:
A【对】若两个突变是同一基因的等位突变且不发生重组，杂交二倍体只产生带突变等位基因的孢子，所有单倍体子代都可能表现为 unhappy。
B【对】若两个突变位于不同基因且独立分配，二倍体减数分裂产生 1/4 带两个野生型等位基因的孢子（happy），3/4 至少带一个突变等位基因（unhappy），即 1:3。
C【对】1:1 不符合独立分配，说明双突变组合可恢复 happy 表型，即两个突变之间存在相互抑制/补偿（基因间互作）。
D【对】随机选取的两个突变多数位于不同基因且不连锁，因此 1:3 是不同基因组合最典型的分离比，也是最常见的观察结果。

questions.question:
Thalassemia, the most common inherited disorder of hemoglobin, is caused by loss or substantial reduction of one of the globin chains. This results in lowered levels of functional hemoglobin and decreased function of red blood cells, which lead to anemia. In α-thalassemia, the α chain of hemoglobin is not produced in sufficient quantity and consequently, hemoglobin tetramers form that contain only the β chain. In β-thalassemia, the β chain of hemoglobin is not produced in sufficient quantity and the α chains form insoluble aggregates that precipitate inside immature red blood cells and prevent differentiation into mature cells.

The normal haploid human genome has one β chain and two α chain coding genes. Presence of four alleles for α chain compared to two alleles for β chain in the cells of normal individuals is expected to result in excess amounts of α chain and production of α aggregates. However, α aggregates do not exist in the cells of normal individuals. One mechanism for maintaining α chains in soluble form was revealed by the discovery of an 11-kDa protein in red blood cells called α-hemoglobin stabilizing protein (AHSP). This protein forms a soluble complex specifically with α chain monomers as they are synthesized. The crystal structure of a complex between AHSP and α-hemoglobin reveals that AHSP binds to the same face of α-globin as does β-globin and ensures the proper folding of α-globin as it is produced. β-globin displaces AHSP when it is expressed.
questions.question_zh:
地中海贫血是最常见的血红蛋白遗传病，由某一种珠蛋白链缺失或大幅减少引起。这会导致有功能的血红蛋白水平降低、红细胞功能下降，从而引起贫血。在 α-地中海贫血中，血红蛋白 α 链合成不足，结果形成只含 β 链的血红蛋白四聚体。在 β-地中海贫血中，β 链合成不足，α 链形成不溶性聚集体，沉积在未成熟红细胞内，阻止其分化为成熟细胞。

正常人类单倍体基因组中有 1 个 β 链编码基因和 2 个 α 链编码基因。正常个体细胞中 α 链有 4 个等位基因，而 β 链只有 2 个，按理应产生过量 α 链并形成 α 聚集体；但正常个体细胞中并不存在 α 聚集体。红细胞中一种 11 kDa 的蛋白——α-血红蛋白稳定蛋白（AHSP）——的发现揭示了一种维持 α 链可溶性的机制。该蛋白在 α 链合成时与其单体特异形成可溶复合物。AHSP 与 α-血红蛋白复合物的晶体结构显示，AHSP 与 β-珠蛋白结合在 α-珠蛋白的同一面，确保 α-珠蛋白在合成过程中正确折叠。β-珠蛋白表达后会将 AHSP 置换下来。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: Higher incidence of severe β-thalassemia compared to severe α-thalassemia could be explained by difference in copy numbers of α and β genes.
subQuestions.text_zh: 重型 β-地中海贫血的发生率高于重型 α-地中海贫血，可以用 α 基因与 β 基因拷贝数的差异来解释。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: α-globin/β-globin ratio is an appropriate marker for screening of β-thalassemia.
subQuestions.text_zh: α-珠蛋白/β-珠蛋白比值是筛查 β-地中海贫血的合适标志物。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: α-Hemoglobin has a higher affinity for β-hemoglobin than for AHSP.
subQuestions.text_zh: α-血红蛋白对 β-血红蛋白的亲和力高于对 AHSP 的亲和力。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: AHSP deleterious mutations are expected to mimic β-thalassemia phenotype with respect to α-chain aggregation.
subQuestions.text_zh: AHSP 的有害突变预计会在 α 链聚集方面模拟 β-地中海贫血的表型。

questions.explanation:
A【对】α 链由两个基因（4 个等位基因）编码，β 链只由一个基因（2 个等位基因）编码；β 基因突变会直接使 β 链减少一半以上，α 链相对过剩并聚集，因此重型 β-地中海贫血更常见、更严重。
B【对】β-地中海贫血时 β 链合成减少，α/β 比值升高；该比值可反映珠蛋白链合成失衡，适合作为筛查指标。
C【对】题干指出 β-珠蛋白表达后会置换 AHSP，说明 α-珠蛋白与 β-珠蛋白的亲和力高于与 AHSP 的亲和力。
D【对】AHSP 的功能是稳定游离 α 链、防止其聚集；AHSP 功能缺失时游离 α 链聚集，表型与 β-地中海贫血中 α 链过剩聚集相似。

questions.question:
Pentose sugars and NADPH are synthesized through the pentose phosphate pathway. Reduced glutathione (GSH) acts to neutralize reactive oxygen species (ROSs) in the body. The reaction for GSH generation is shown below.

Individuals with glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase (G6PD) deficiency have decreased levels of NADPH, which can cause the favism disorder. Compared to other populations, the frequency of G6PD deficiency is higher in Africans, and its prevalence in Africa positively correlates with the prevalence of malaria.
questions.question_zh:
戊糖和 NADPH 通过戊糖磷酸途径合成。还原型谷胱甘肽（GSH）在体内中和活性氧（ROS）。GSH 生成的反应如下所示。

葡萄糖-6-磷酸脱氢酶（G6PD）缺陷者的 NADPH 水平降低，可引起蚕豆病（favism）。与其他人群相比，非洲人群中 G6PD 缺陷的频率更高，且其在非洲的流行率与疟疾流行率呈正相关。

images.caption: The pentose phosphate pathway: oxidative phase produces NADPH and ribulose-5-phosphate; non-oxidative phase interconverts sugar phosphates.
images.caption_zh: 戊糖磷酸途径：氧化阶段产生 NADPH 与核酮糖-5-磷酸；非氧化阶段进行糖磷酸之间的相互转化。

images.caption: Glutathione reductase regenerates GSH from GSSG using NADPH.
images.caption_zh: 谷胱甘肽还原酶利用 NADPH 将 GSSG 还原为 GSH。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: The high prevalence of G6PD deficiency in regions with high incidence of malaria can be explained by high susceptibility of Plasmodium falciparum to oxidative agents.
subQuestions.text_zh: 在疟疾高发地区 G6PD 缺陷高发，可以用恶性疟原虫（Plasmodium falciparum）对氧化剂高度敏感来解释。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Increase in levels of cell division is accompanied by increase in the ratio of fructose-6 phosphate/ribose-5 phosphate production by the pentose phosphate pathway.
subQuestions.text_zh: 细胞分裂水平升高时，戊糖磷酸途径产生的果糖-6-磷酸/核糖-5-磷酸比值也随之升高。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: G6PD deficiency affects catabolism more than anabolism in individuals with the deficiency.
subQuestions.text_zh: 在 G6PD 缺陷个体中，该缺陷对分解代谢的影响大于对合成代谢的影响。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: It is expected that the cause of favism in some affected individuals may be glutathione reductase deficiency.
subQuestions.text_zh: 可以预期，某些患者的蚕豆病病因可能是谷胱甘肽还原酶缺陷。

questions.explanation:
A【对】G6PD 缺陷使 NADPH 不足、GSH 再生受阻，红细胞抗氧化能力下降；疟原虫对氧化损伤敏感，因此杂合子在疟疾高发区具有相对生存优势，使该缺陷频率维持在较高水平。
B【错】细胞分裂旺盛时需要大量核糖-5-磷酸来合成核苷酸，戊糖磷酸途径应更多产生 R5P，F6P/R5P 比值下降而不是升高。
C【错】G6PD 通过 NADPH 参与还原性合成与抗氧化防御，主要影响合成代谢和氧化还原平衡，而不是分解代谢。
D【对】谷胱甘肽还原酶负责利用 NADPH 将 GSSG 还原为 GSH；该酶缺陷同样导致 GSH 不足、红细胞易受氧化损伤，可产生类似蚕豆病的溶血表现。

questions.question:
DNA polymerase III holoenzyme consists of the pol III* and the β-clamp which hold pol III* and the DNA template together. You are investigating whether, during lagging strand synthesis, the pol III* synthesizing the lagging strand dissociates from the β-clamp as it finishes one Okazaki fragment and re-associates with another β-clamp to begin making the next Okazaki fragment. You prepared a primed M13 phage (a single-stranded DNA and a primer) template (M13mp18) as a donor and loaded a β-clamp and pol III* onto it.

As acceptors, you then added two more primed phage DNA templates, one (M13Gori) preloaded with a β-clamp and the other (ΦX174) lacking a β-clamp (Figure A). You incubated the templates together under replication conditions for 90 min – long enough for the donor and acceptors to be replicated – then performed gel electrophoresis (Figure B, lanes 1–4). You then repeated the experiment but now loading a β-clamp on ΦX174 instead of M13Gori (Figure B, lanes 5–8).
questions.question_zh:
DNA 聚合酶 III 全酶由 pol III* 与 β-夹（β-clamp）组成，后者将 pol III* 与 DNA 模板固定在一起。你正在研究：在后随链合成过程中，合成后随链的 pol III* 在完成一个冈崎片段后，是否从 β-夹上解离，并与另一个 β-夹结合以开始合成下一个冈崎片段。你制备了带引物的 M13 噬菌体（单链 DNA 加引物）模板（M13mp18）作为供体，并在其上加载了 β-夹和 pol III*。

随后加入另外两个带引物的噬菌体 DNA 模板作为受体：一个（M13Gori）预先加载了 β-夹，另一个（ΦX174）没有 β-夹（图 A）。将模板在复制条件下共同孵育 90 分钟——足以让供体和受体都完成复制——然后进行凝胶电泳（图 B，泳道 1–4）。随后重复实验，但改为在 ΦX174 上加载 β-夹，而不是在 M13Gori 上（图 B，泳道 5–8）。

images.caption: A: Donor M13mp18 preloaded with pol III* and β-clamp; acceptors M13Gori (with β-clamp) and ΦX174 (without β-clamp). B: Gel electrophoresis of replication products at 15–90 s.
images.caption_zh: A：供体 M13mp18 预载 pol III* 与 β-夹；受体 M13Gori（有 β-夹）与 ΦX174（无 β-夹）。B：15–90 秒复制产物的凝胶电泳。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: After replication has finished, Pol III* dissociates from its original β-clamp.
subQuestions.text_zh: 复制完成后，Pol III* 从其原来的 β-夹上解离。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: The data are consistent with the notion that the β-clamp is not absolutely required for replication.
subQuestions.text_zh: 这些数据与“β-夹并非复制绝对必需”的观点一致。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: Pol III* prefers an acceptor template preloaded with a β-clamp.
subQuestions.text_zh: Pol III* 优先选择预先加载了 β-夹的受体模板。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: Based on the results, one β-clamp is enough to synthesize all Okazaki fragments on the lagging strand of each replication fork.
subQuestions.text_zh: 根据结果，一个 β-夹足以合成每个复制叉后随链上的全部冈崎片段。

questions.explanation:
A【对】供体复制完成后，Pol III* 转移到新加入的受体模板上继续复制；凝胶中供体条带不再持续增强，说明 Pol III* 可以从原来的 β-夹解离。
B【对】当 β-夹加载在 M13Gori 上时，无 β-夹的 ΦX174 仍出现复制产物（泳道 6–8），说明 β-夹不是复制的绝对必需条件。
C【对】当 β-夹加载在 ΦX174 上时，ΦX174 的复制产物显著增强，而 M13Gori 产物减弱，说明 Pol III* 优先利用预载 β-夹的受体。
D【错】Pol III* 每完成一个冈崎片段便解离并重新结合新的 β-夹，因此一个 β-夹不足以合成后随链上的全部冈崎片段。

questions.question:
The enzymatic reaction below includes two steps.

para-nitrophenyl-peptide → para-nitrophenol + peptide

Para-nitrophenol has maximum absorbance at wavelength 405 nm. The progress curve of the reaction is shown below.
questions.question_zh:
下面的酶促反应包括两个步骤。

对硝基苯基-肽 → 对硝基苯酚 + 肽

对硝基苯酚在 405 nm 波长处有最大吸收。该反应的进程曲线如下图所示。

images.caption: Progress curve of para-nitrophenol formation. Region a: initial burst; region b: steady-state phase.
images.caption_zh: 对硝基苯酚生成的进程曲线。区域 a：初始爆发阶段；区域 b：稳态阶段。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: The release of para-nitrophenol occurs during the first step of the enzymatic mechanism.
subQuestions.text_zh: 对硝基苯酚的释放发生在酶促机制的第一步。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: The rate limiting step of this enzymatic mechanism is the second step.
subQuestions.text_zh: 该酶促机制的限速步骤是第二步。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: Enzyme activity can be determined from the slope of region “a” of the curve.
subQuestions.text_zh: 酶活性可以由曲线区域“a”的斜率确定。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: One of the reaction products activates the enzyme.
subQuestions.text_zh: 反应产物之一会激活该酶。

questions.explanation:
A【对】曲线起始阶段（区域 a）快速上升，代表第一步迅速释放对硝基苯酚的“爆发”阶段。
B【对】初始快速释放后转入缓慢的稳态阶段（区域 b），说明第二步是慢步骤，即限速步骤。
C【错】区域 a 是前稳态/爆发阶段，其斜率受酶与底物快速反应及混合死时间影响，不能代表稳态酶活性；应由区域 b 的稳态斜率测定。
D【错】若产物激活酶，速率应随时间加快（上凸曲线），而图中速率由快转慢并趋于线性，与产物激活不符。

questions.question_zh:
蛋白质降解产生的氨基酸可以进一步代谢，转化为柠檬酸循环的中间产物。下面是由标记蛋白质降解得到的标记氨基酸。

三羧酸循环（Krebs 循环）如下图所示。注意：大多数 α-氨基酸可通过转氨反应直接转化为相应的 α-酮酸，如下图所示。

images.caption: Labelled aspartate, glutamate and alanine. The star marks the 14C-labelled carbon.
images.caption_zh: 标记的天冬氨酸、谷氨酸和丙氨酸。星号表示 14C 标记的碳原子。

images.caption: The citric acid cycle and transamination reaction.
images.caption_zh: 柠檬酸循环与转氨反应。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: Upon introduction of the aspartate into the Krebs cycle, label will first appear in oxaloacetate.
subQuestions.text_zh: 天冬氨酸进入 Krebs 循环后，标记将首先出现在草酰乙酸中。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Upon introduction of the alanine into the Krebs cycle, label will first appear in citrate.
subQuestions.text_zh: 丙氨酸进入 Krebs 循环后，标记将首先出现在柠檬酸中。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: Labelled alanine will yield 14-CO2 during the first turn of the cycle.
subQuestions.text_zh: 标记的丙氨酸将在循环的第一轮产生 14CO2。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: Labelled glutamate will yield 14-CO2 in the second turn of the cycle.
subQuestions.text_zh: 标记的谷氨酸将在循环的第二轮产生 14CO2。

questions.explanation:
A【对】天冬氨酸经转氨反应直接生成草酰乙酸，标记碳随之进入草酰乙酸，因此首先出现在草酰乙酸。
B【对】丙氨酸经转氨生成丙酮酸，再经丙酮酸脱氢酶生成乙酰-CoA；乙酰-CoA 与草酰乙酸缩合生成柠檬酸，因此标记首先出现在柠檬酸。
C【错】丙氨酸的标记碳进入乙酰-CoA 的羰基碳；TCA 第一轮释放的 CO2 来自草酰乙酸的两个羧基，乙酰-CoA 来源的碳要到第二轮才释放，故第一轮不产生 14CO2。
D【对】谷氨酸经转氨生成 α-酮戊二酸，其标记碳进入 TCA 中间产物；该碳在后续反应中于第二轮循环以 14CO2 释放。

questions.question:
In figure a, the pain and temperature sensory pathway is depicted. The first-order neuron enters the spinal cord and forms a synapse with the second-order neuron, whose axon ends in the thalamus. The third-order neuron transmits the information to the brain cortex. Figure b shows the vibration and proprioception (joint position) sensory pathway. The axon terminals of the first-order neurons are located in the brain stem and form synapses with second-order neurons, which cross the midline and their axons end in the thalamus. Finally, the sensory information is conducted to the cortex via the third-order neurons.

Following a spinal injury, the right ventral and left dorsal sides of the white matter in the thoracolumbar spinal cord are damaged.
questions.question_zh:
图 a 展示痛觉与温度觉感觉通路。一级神经元进入脊髓，与二级神经元形成突触，二级神经元的轴突终止于丘脑。三级神经元将信息传至大脑皮层。图 b 展示振动觉与本体感觉（关节位置觉）通路。一级神经元的轴突末梢位于脑干，与二级神经元形成突触；二级神经元交叉过中线，其轴突终止于丘脑。最后，感觉信息经三级神经元传至皮层。

一次脊髓损伤后，胸腰段脊髓白质的右侧腹侧和左侧背侧受损。

images.caption: a: Pain and temperature pathway (crosses in the spinal cord, ascends in the anterolateral column). b: Vibration and proprioception pathway (ascends in the dorsal column, crosses in the brainstem).
images.caption_zh: a：痛觉与温度觉通路（在脊髓内交叉，经脊髓前外侧索上行）。b：振动觉与本体感觉通路（经脊髓背索上行，在脑干交叉）。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: The patient has impaired temperature sensation in right hand.
subQuestions.text_zh: 患者右手温度觉受损。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: The patient has impaired vibration sensation in left leg.
subQuestions.text_zh: 患者左腿振动觉受损。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: The patient has impaired joint position sensation in left leg and temperature sensation in right leg.
subQuestions.text_zh: 患者左腿关节位置觉和右腿温度觉均受损。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: The patient has impaired pain sensation in left leg.
subQuestions.text_zh: 患者左腿痛觉受损。

questions.explanation:
A【错】右手的感觉纤维在颈段脊髓，胸腰段损伤不会影响手部温度觉。
B【对】左腿的振动觉/本体感觉经左侧背索同侧上行；左侧背侧白质受损，故左腿振动觉受损。
C【错】左腿关节位置觉确实受损（左背索），但右腿的痛温觉纤维在左侧脊髓交叉后经左侧前外侧索上行；左侧腹侧未受损，因此右腿温度觉不应受损。
D【对】左腿痛温觉纤维在脊髓内交叉到右侧前外侧索上行；右侧腹侧白质受损，故左腿痛觉受损。

questions.question: Perception of emotional stimuli is a reciprocal process between the brain and the heart. In an experimental task, pictures depicting facial expressions were quickly and sequentially presented to the subjects at different phases of the cardiac cycle. Participants then rated the emotional intensity of the faces on a scale of 0 to 100. Given the role of the amygdala in the process of fear, the amygdala response was measured in normal individuals and subjects with pure autonomic failure (PAF) at the time of presenting facial expression images (using the fMRI method). The results of the study are as follows. (Consider p < 0.05 indicates significant difference between groups.)
questions.question_zh: 情绪刺激的知觉是大脑与心脏之间的双向过程。在一项实验任务中，向受试者在心动周期的不同阶段快速、连续地呈现表情图片。随后，受试者按 0–100 分评定面孔的情绪强度。鉴于杏仁核在恐惧加工中的作用，研究使用 fMRI 在呈现表情图片时测量正常个体和纯自主神经衰竭（PAF）受试者的杏仁核反应。研究结果如下。（p < 0.05 表示组间差异显著。）

images.caption: Fear and neutral face perception during systole (S) and late diastole (D), with right amygdala responses in controls and PAF subjects.
images.caption_zh: 收缩期（S）与舒张晚期（D）对恐惧/中性面孔的知觉评分，以及正常对照与 PAF 受试者的右侧杏仁核反应。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: Perception of the fear face in the systolic phase is higher than the diastole phase.
subQuestions.text_zh: 收缩期对恐惧面孔的知觉高于舒张期。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: The difference between systolic and diastolic response of the amygdala to neutral face images is the opposite of facial expressions of fear.
subQuestions.text_zh: 杏仁核对中性面孔的收缩期与舒张期反应差异，与对恐惧表情的差异方向相反。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: Increasing the arterial baroreceptors sensitivity in the carotid and aorta may cause a significant reduction in the perception of the fear.
subQuestions.text_zh: 提高颈动脉和主动脉的压力感受器敏感性，可能显著降低恐惧知觉。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: Increased blood flow to amygdala in the systolic phase compare to the diastole phase cannot explain the results of this study.
subQuestions.text_zh: 收缩期杏仁核血流量高于舒张期，不能解释本研究的结果。

questions.explanation:
A【对】图中恐惧强度评分在收缩期（S）约为 74–75，显著高于舒张期（D）约 70–71（p < 0.05）。

questions.question:
When a light beam enters another medium at an oblique angle, its direction will change. This phenomenon is called light refraction. The amount of this change in beam direction can be calculated by Snell’s law, where “n” is the refraction index.

This phenomenon is also the principle of conversion and diversion of beams in lenses. Power of a lens can be calculated by the following formula. Optical power of a lens demonstrates the degree of convergence or divergence of the light beam.

(D: Power of lens, r: radius of curvature)

D = (n1 − n2)/r

The figure below shows the eye structure of Anableps sp., which can simultaneously see objects in both aquatic and terrestrial scenes.
questions.question_zh:
当光束以斜角进入另一种介质时，其传播方向会发生改变。这种现象称为光的折射。方向改变量可用斯涅尔定律计算，其中“n”为折射率。

这一现象也是透镜中光束会聚与发散的原理。透镜的屈光力可用下式计算。透镜的光焦度表示光束会聚或发散的程度。

（D：透镜屈光力；r：曲率半径）

D = (n1 − n2)/r

下图显示 Anableps sp.（四眼鱼）的眼结构；该鱼可同时看清水中与陆地上的物体。

subQuestions.text_zh: 折射率最大的是晶状体。

subQuestions.label: B

subQuestions.text_zh: 折射量最大的是晶状体。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: The light beam would be more divergent when passing through the aqueous humour than the cornea.
subQuestions.text_zh: 光束通过房水时比通过角膜时更趋于发散。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: Considering the different diameters of the lens of Anableps fish, light ray 1 and 2 belong to terrestrial and aquatic spaces, respectively.
subQuestions.text_zh: 考虑到 Anableps 晶状体上下直径不同，光线 1 和 2 分别属于陆地与水中空间。

questions.explanation:
A【对】图 c 给出折射率：空气 1、角膜 1.376、房水 1.337、晶状体 1.406，晶状体最高。
B【错】屈光力 D=(n1−n2)/r 不仅取决于折射率差，还取决于曲率半径。角膜前表面半径 7.259 mm、空气—角膜折射率差 0.376，D≈0.052；晶状体前后表面 D 仅约 0.008–0.011，远小于角膜。因此折射量最大的是角膜，不是晶状体。
C【对】房水与玻璃体折射率接近（1.337），光线通过时几乎不发生折射；角膜—空气界面折射率差最大，产生明显会聚。因此相对于角膜，房水对光束的会聚作用很小，光束更趋于发散。
D【对】Anableps 的晶状体上下部分直径/曲率不同，分别适应空气与水中不同的折射需求；图 c 中光线 1、2 分别对应陆地与水中视野。

questions.question: Thyroid hormones are transported in blood by proteins. TBG (thyroid hormone binding globulin) is the main thyroid hormone transporting protein. Many factors affect TBG concentration, such as oestrogen and OCP (oral contraceptive pill), etc. OCP increases TBG concentration. The T3RU (T3 resin uptake) assay is a method of quantification of unbound TBG in the blood. It indirectly measures the capacity of the patient’s TBG to bind radioactively labelled T3. The lower the patient’s thyroid hormone level, the more radioactively labelled T3 will bind to TBG. Thus, since radioactive T3 is only detectable in unbound form, the T3RU assay result will be lower.
questions.question_zh: 甲状腺激素在血液中由蛋白质运输。TBG（甲状腺激素结合球蛋白）是主要的甲状腺激素运输蛋白。许多因素会影响 TBG 浓度，如雌激素和 OCP（口服避孕药）等。OCP 会升高 TBG 浓度。T3RU（T3 树脂摄取）试验用于定量血液中未结合的 TBG，间接测定患者 TBG 结合放射性标记 T3 的能力。患者甲状腺激素水平越低，与 TBG 结合的放射性 T3 就越多。因此，由于放射性 T3 只有未结合形式可被检测，T3RU 试验结果会降低。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: In primary hypothyroidism, the thyroid function test would be like below: TSH increased, T4 decreased, T3RU decreased.
subQuestions.text_zh: 在原发性甲状腺功能减退症中，甲状腺功能检查结果如下：TSH 升高，T4 降低，T3RU 降低。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: A person who uses OCP and is euthyroid (normal functioning of thyroid) the thyroid function test would be like below: TSH normal, T4 decreased, T3RU decreased.
subQuestions.text_zh: 使用 OCP 且甲状腺功能正常（euthyroid）的人，甲状腺功能检查结果如下：TSH 正常，T4 降低，T3RU 降低。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: In primary hyperthyroidism the thyroid function test would be like below: TSH increased, T4 increased, T3RU increased.
subQuestions.text_zh: 在原发性甲状腺功能亢进症中，甲状腺功能检查结果如下：TSH 升高，T4 升高，T3RU 升高。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: In secondary hypothyroidism (pituitary dysfunction) the thyroid function test would be like below: TSH decreased, T4 decreased, T3RU decreased.
subQuestions.text_zh: 在继发性甲状腺功能减退症（垂体功能障碍）中，甲状腺功能检查结果如下：TSH 降低，T4 降低，T3RU 降低。

subQuestions.label: E
subQuestions.text: In tertiary hypothyroidism (hypothalamic dysfunction) the thyroid function test would be like below: TSH normal, T4 decreased, T3RU decreased.
subQuestions.text_zh: 在三发性甲状腺功能减退症（下丘脑功能障碍）中，甲状腺功能检查结果如下：TSH 正常，T4 降低，T3RU 降低。

questions.explanation:
A【对】原发性甲减时甲状腺本身功能低下，T4 降低；负反馈减弱使 TSH 升高。TBG 结合位点空出更多，更多放射性 T3 与 TBG 结合，T3RU 降低。
B【错】OCP 使 TBG 升高，总 T4 随之升高（而不是降低）；游离 T4 与 TSH 维持正常，T3RU 因 TBG 增多而降低。
C【错】原发性甲亢时 T4 升高，负反馈增强使 TSH 降低（而不是升高）；T3RU 升高。
D【对】继发性甲减由垂体功能低下引起，TSH 降低、T4 降低、T3RU 降低。
E【错】三发性甲减由下丘脑 TRH 不足引起，TSH 降低（而不是正常），T4 降低、T3RU 降低。

questions.question:
Spermatozoa motility is essential for the fertilization of an oocyte. In most animals, including fish, spermatozoa are immotile in the male reproductive organ (testis or sperm duct). Spermatozoa motility is triggered after being ejaculated into the female reproductive tract (in animals with internal fertilization) or after it is released into the aquatic environment (in animals with external fertilization).

Ionic composition and osmolality of freshwater, seawater, and seminal plasma of pike (Esox lucius), sturgeon (Acipenser ruthenus), and cod (Gadus morhua) are shown in the table. Pike and sturgeon spawn in freshwater, and cod spawns in seawater.
questions.question_zh:

questions.question:
Nasopharyngeal carcinoma is closely associated with Epstein–Barr virus (EBV) infection. In a recent prospective study involving more than 20,000 participants, detection of EBV DNA in plasma was shown to be useful in screening for nasopharyngeal carcinoma. However, 5.4% of participants without nasopharyngeal carcinoma had detectable EBV DNA in plasma at recruitment. The figure below shows the effect of ambient temperature on test results.

Sensitivity refers to the test’s ability to correctly detect affected patients who do have the condition. It is calculated as: number of affected patients with positive tests / total number of affected individuals studied.

Specificity relates to the test’s ability to correctly identify those without disease. It is calculated as: number of healthy individuals with negative tests / total number of healthy individuals studied.
questions.question_zh:
鼻咽癌与 EB 病毒（EBV）感染密切相关。最近一项纳入 2 万多名受试者的前瞻性研究表明，检测血浆中的 EBV DNA 可用于鼻咽癌筛查。然而，在招募时，5.4% 的无鼻咽癌受试者血浆中也可检测到 EBV DNA。下图显示环境温度对检测结果的影响。

敏感度指检测正确发现真正患病者的能力，计算为：检测阳性的患病人数 / 受检患病人数。

特异度指检测正确识别无病者的能力，计算为：检测阴性的健康人数 / 受检健康人数。

images.caption: Percentage of participants without nasopharyngeal carcinoma who tested positive for EBV DNA, plotted against mean ambient temperature on the day of sample collection.
images.caption_zh: 无鼻咽癌受试者中 EBV DNA 检测阳性的百分比，与采样当天平均环境温度的关系。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: Based on the figure above, performing the test in warmer places will increase the specificity.
subQuestions.text_zh: 根据上图，在较温暖的地方进行检测会提高特异度。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: When a test becomes more sensitive, the specificity of the test will increase.
subQuestions.text_zh: 当检测变得更敏感时，其特异度也会提高。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: A 100% specific test will be 100% sensitive.
subQuestions.text_zh: 100% 特异的检测也一定是 100% 敏感的。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: To rule out a disease, it is better to use a test with high sensitivity instead of a test with high specificity.
subQuestions.text_zh: 为了排除某种疾病，最好使用高敏感度的检测，而不是高特异度的检测。

questions.explanation:
A【对】图中无鼻咽癌者的 EBV DNA 阳性率随环境温度升高而下降；无病人群假阳性减少，意味着特异度提高。
B【错】敏感度与特异度通常存在权衡：提高敏感度往往以降低特异度（更多假阳性）为代价，二者不会同步提高。
C【错】特异度 100% 只说明无病者不会被误判为阳性，与能否检出真正患者（敏感度）无关；检测可能完全不敏感。
D【对】排除疾病时希望尽量减少漏诊，高敏感度检测的假阴性少，阴性结果更有把握排除疾病；高特异度更适合用于确诊。

questions.question: The early embryonic cells pass through two stages of differentiation: specification and determination. In the experiment shown below, a labelled donor region was transplanted orthotopically, cultured in isolation, or grafted heterotopically at early or late stages.
questions.question_zh: 早期胚胎细胞经历两个分化阶段：特化（specification）与决定（determination）。在下面所示的实验中，将标记的供体区域按原位移植、单独培养，或在早期/晚期异位移植。

images.caption: (a) Orthotopic graft gives the normal fate. (b) Isolation of an early graft in vitro gives a red spinous sphere (specification). (c) Early heterotopic graft shows no determination. (d) Late heterotopic graft shows determination.
images.caption_zh: （a）原位移植获得正常命运。（b）早期移植块离体培养形成红色棘球（特化）。（c）早期异位移植未表现决定。（d）晚期异位移植表现决定。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: These data support that the fate of the determined cell is not reversible.
subQuestions.text_zh: 这些数据支持“已决定细胞的命运不可逆”这一观点。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: The cell that is specified loses its other differentiation potentials.
subQuestions.text_zh: 已特化的细胞会失去其他分化潜能。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: If the graft is removed at the late stage and cultured in isolation, it will give rise to the red spinous sphere (shown in the picture).
subQuestions.text_zh: 如果在晚期取出移植块并单独培养，它将形成图中所示的红色棘球。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: If the graft is removed at the late stage and cultured in the presence of the eye inducing factors, the eye-like structure will be developed.
subQuestions.text_zh: 如果在晚期取出移植块并在眼诱导因子存在下培养，将发育出眼样结构。

questions.explanation:

questions.question: Uljanin in 1870 discovered a group of marine, soft-bodied, unsegmented hermaphroditic worms without hindgut and coelom. The mouth in these worms opens to a central digestive parenchyma. They moved with their multiciliated epidermis, although many were ‘surprisingly muscular’. Most of the species were free-living and some were ectocommensals. It has now been shown that several species form obligate symbioses with green algae, making them functional photoautotroph organisms. Later, the phylogenetic position of these multicellular organisms was studied using the complete mitochondrial genome of a member of this group (Symsagittifera roscoffensis), which has been given in the figure below.
questions.question_zh: Uljanin 于 1870 年发现了一类海生、柔软、不分节、雌雄同体的蠕虫，无后肠、无体腔。这类蠕虫的口通向中央消化实质。它们依靠多纤毛表皮运动，尽管许多种类“肌肉出奇地发达”。大多数种类自由生活，少数为外共生。现已表明，若干物种与绿藻形成专性共生，使其成为功能性光自养生物。随后，利用该组一个成员（Symsagittifera roscoffensis）的完整线粒体基因组研究了这些多细胞生物的系统发育位置，结果如下图所示。

images.caption: Phylogenetic tree based on complete mitochondrial genomes, showing the position of Symsagittifera (Acoelomorpha) relative to Deuterostomia and other Bilateria.
images.caption_zh: 基于完整线粒体基因组的系统发育树，显示 Symsagittifera（Acoelomorpha）相对于后口动物及其他两侧对称动物的位置。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: Based on this tree, Acoelomorpha is a sister group of Deuterostomia.
subQuestions.text_zh: 根据该树，Acoelomorpha 是后口动物（Deuterostomia）的姐妹群。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Based on the above given description, the identified worm is a triploblastic acoelomate.
subQuestions.text_zh: 根据上述描述，所鉴定的蠕虫是三胚层无体腔动物。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: Based on the above given text, the identified worm has incomplete digestive system.
subQuestions.text_zh: 根据上述文字，所鉴定的蠕虫具有不完全消化系统。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: The provided data is consistent with the hypothesis that the identified worm belongs to the earliest diverging lineage of Bilateria.
subQuestions.text_zh: 所给数据与“该蠕虫属于两侧对称动物最早分化出的谱系”这一假说一致。

questions.explanation:
A【错】树中 Xenacoelomorpha（含 Acoelomorpha）位于所有其它两侧对称动物的基部，是 Bilateria 的姐妹群；Deuterostomia 只是其中一个独立分支，并非 Acoelomorpha 的姐妹群。
B【对】题干描述其无体腔、具三胚层来源的组织与器官，属于三胚层无体腔动物。
C【对】口通向中央消化实质、无后肠，属于不完全消化系统（只有一个开口）。
D【对】系统发育树显示 Acoelomorpha 是最早分化出的两侧对称动物谱系，与假说一致。

questions.question: In 1876, Van Beneden found a group of microscopic ciliated wormlike organisms that inhabited the renal sacs of cephalopods, mainly octopuses and cuttlefishes, and named them Dicyemids. Biologists have been fascinated because of their highly simplified body organization and complex life cycles of asexual (under normal conditions producing vermiform larva in host kidney) and sexual (under crowded conditions producing infusoriform larva excreted in host urine) reproduction. These ciliated animals are composed of approximately 20–30 (or 40) cells arranged in two layers, and they lack coeloms, circulatory systems, and other differentiated tissues; their embryos employ spiral cleavage. Due to their simple body plans, they can be considered as intermediates between the Protozoa and the Metazoa. The phylogenetic position of dicyemids suggested by previous phylogenetic studies remains controversial.
questions.question_zh: 1876 年，Van Beneden 发现了一类微小的具纤毛蠕虫样生物，栖息于头足类（主要是章鱼和乌贼）的肾囊中，并将其命名为二胚虫（Dicyemids）。其高度简化的身体结构和复杂的生活史令生物学家着迷：无性生殖（正常情况下在宿主肾内产生蠕虫状幼虫）与有性生殖（拥挤条件下产生纤毛虫状幼虫，随宿主尿液排出）。这些具纤毛的动物由约 20–30（或 40）个细胞组成，排列成两层；它们缺乏体腔、循环系统和其他分化组织，胚胎采用螺旋卵裂。由于其简单的身体构型，它们曾被认为是原生动物与后生动物之间的中间类型。以往系统发育研究提示的二胚虫系统位置仍有争议。

images.caption: Phylogenetic trees based on 18S rRNA, 18S + 28S rRNA, and innexin amino acid sequences, showing the position of Dicyemida.
images.caption_zh: 基于 18S rRNA、18S + 28S rRNA 及 innexin 氨基酸序列的系统发育树，显示二胚虫的位置。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: Based on the above explanations, infusiform larva is a mean of dispersal for these animals.
subQuestions.text_zh: 根据上述解释，纤毛虫状幼虫是这类动物的一种扩散方式。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Based on the above molecular data, these animals are missing link between Metazoa and protozoa.
subQuestions.text_zh: 根据上述分子数据，这些动物是后生动物与原生动物之间的缺失环节。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: Based on the data, these described animals faced a regression evolution during its evolutionary history.
subQuestions.text_zh: 根据数据，这些动物在进化历史中经历了退化演化。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: Based on the given data, it is more likely that Dicyemida is more closely related to Mollusca than to Ecdysozoa.
subQuestions.text_zh: 根据所给数据，二胚虫与软体动物的亲缘关系比与蜕皮动物更近。

questions.explanation:
A【对】有性生殖产生的纤毛虫状幼虫随宿主尿液排出，可进入新的宿主，是扩散/传播阶段。
B【错】分子系统发育把二胚虫归入后生动物（Spiralia/Lophotrochozoa），并非原生动物与后生动物之间的缺失环节；其简单结构是次生简化。
C【对】二胚虫处于后生动物内部，却缺少体腔、循环系统等，说明其身体结构在寄生生活中发生了次生退化（regression evolution）。
D【对】18S + 28S 及 innexin 树均把二胚虫置于 Spiralia 内，靠近软体动物/环节动物，而与蜕皮动物较远；18S 单基因树的异常位置可用长枝吸引解释。

questions.question:
Anthocyanins are vacuolar pigments that consist of two phenyl rings and one heterocyclic ring. They are the source of red to blue colours of flowers and fruits. Changes of vacuolar and soil pH, formation of complexes with metal ions, and introduction of –OH groups particularly at 3′ and 5′ positions and subsequent methylations at these positions all result in production of variations in the colours of the pigments.

For example, increase in the number of hydroxyl groups or complex formation with metal ions shifts absorption of the pigments to longer wavelengths, whereas methoxyl groups (OCH3) shift absorption to slightly shorter wavelengths. Given that pelargonidin (1) is the most abundant pigment in variety A of Tropical Water Lily flowers (Nymphaea spp.), indicate if each of the following statements is true or false.
questions.question_zh:
花青素是位于液泡中的色素，由两个苯环和一个杂环构成，是花果呈现红至蓝色的来源。液泡与土壤 pH 的变化、与金属离子形成复合物、在 3′ 和 5′ 位引入 –OH 以及随后在这些位点发生甲基化，都会造成色素颜色的变化。

例如，羟基数增加或与金属离子形成复合物会使色素吸收峰向长波方向移动，而甲氧基（OCH3）会使吸收峰略向短波方向移动。已知花葵素（pelargonidin，结构 1）是睡莲（Nymphaea spp.）品种 A 中含量最高的色素，判断下列各陈述是否正确。

images.caption: Flowers A–E of Nymphaea varieties used in the study.
images.caption_zh: 研究中使用的睡莲品种 A–E 的花。

images.caption: Structures of anthocyanin pigments 1–6. Pigment 6 is a complex with Al3+.
images.caption_zh: 花青素色素 1–6 的结构。色素 6 为与 Al3+ 形成的复合物。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: Pigment 3 is the most abundant pigment in flower E.
subQuestions.text_zh: 色素 3 是花 E 中含量最高的色素。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: In Nymphaea variety C, pigment 4 is more abundant than 5.
subQuestions.text_zh: 在睡莲品种 C 中，色素 4 的含量高于色素 5。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: Compared to the other flowers, pigment 6 is mostly abundant in flower D.
subQuestions.text_zh: 与其他花相比，色素 6 在花 D 中含量最高。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: The colour of flower B is explained by presence of higher levels of pigment 2 as compared to pigment 1.
subQuestions.text_zh: 花 B 的颜色可以用色素 2 的含量高于色素 1 来解释。

questions.explanation:
A【对】花 E 呈蓝紫色。结构 3 在 3′、5′ 位比结构 1 多两个羟基，羟基化使吸收峰红移、颜色偏蓝，符合花 E 的蓝紫色。
B【错】花 C 为深红色。结构 4 羟基更多、偏蓝，结构 5 有甲氧基、偏红；若 4 多于 5，花色应更偏蓝而非深红，故该说法与花 C 的颜色不符。
C【错】结构 6 是与 Al3+ 的络合物，通常使颜色更偏蓝；花 D 为红色，不应以 6 为主。
D【错】结构 2 含两个甲氧基，吸收偏短波、颜色偏红；结构 1（花葵素）本身偏橙红。花 B 为蓝紫色，不能由“2 多于 1”解释。

questions.question: Boron (B) is an essential micronutrient for plants. Its uptake, transport, and function in plants appear to be dependent on the formation of B complexes with sugars, such as sorbitol in phloem sap (Fig. 1) and a specific dimerized form of pectin in growing cell walls. Yokota and Konishi (1999) studied the effect of various exogenously supplied sugars including sucrose, glucose, and fructose on promotion of pollen tube growth by formation of sugar-borate complexes. Pollens were cultivated at different concentrations of B for 20 hours. The effect of sugars on the pH of the media is shown in Table 1, and the length of pollen tubes incubated with the various sugars is shown in Fig. 2.
questions.question_zh: 硼（B）是植物必需的微量营养元素。其在植物体内的吸收、运输和功能似乎依赖于硼与糖形成复合物，例如韧皮部汁液中的山梨醇（图 1）以及正在生长的细胞壁中特定二聚化形式的果胶。Yokota 与 Konishi（1999）研究了外源提供的各种糖（包括蔗糖、葡萄糖和果糖）通过形成糖-硼酸复合物促进花粉管生长的作用。花粉在不同 B 浓度下培养 20 小时。糖对培养基 pH 的影响见表 1，不同糖处理下花粉管长度见图 2。

tables.title: Table 1. Changes in pH of pollen culture media containing different sugars after adding boric acid at different concentrations
head: H3BO3 (mM)

tables_zh.title: 表 1. 加入不同浓度硼酸后，含不同糖的花粉培养基 pH 变化
head: H3BO3（mM）

images.caption: Figure 1. Boron–sorbitol complex.
images.caption_zh: 图 1. 硼-山梨醇复合物。

images.caption: Figure 2. Pollen tube length after incubation with sucrose, glucose or fructose at different boric acid concentrations.
images.caption_zh: 图 2. 不同硼酸浓度下，蔗糖、葡萄糖或果糖处理后花粉管长度。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: Growth inhibition of pollen tubes by high concentrations of B is more pronounced in medium containing sucrose as compared to fructose.
subQuestions.text_zh: 高浓度 B 对花粉管生长的抑制在含蔗糖的培养基中比在含果糖的培养基中更明显。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: At low B concentrations (5 mM), growth inhibition of pollen tubes was more pronounced in medium containing glucose as compared to the other sugars.
subQuestions.text_zh: 在低 B 浓度（5 mM）下，含葡萄糖的培养基对花粉管生长的抑制比其它糖更明显。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: Inhibitory effects of fructose on pollen tube growth increased with increasing concentrations of B.
subQuestions.text_zh: 果糖对花粉管生长的抑制效应随 B 浓度升高而增强。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: Based on effects of sugar on pH of the media, relative levels of sugar-B complex formation is as follows: Sucrose < Glucose < Fructose.
subQuestions.text_zh: 根据糖对培养基 pH 的影响，糖-硼复合物形成的相对水平为：蔗糖 < 葡萄糖 < 果糖。

questions.explanation:
A【对】图 2 中，高 B（10–20 mM）时蔗糖组花粉管长度由约 2.2 mm 降至 0.6–1.1 mm，而果糖组仍维持在 2.8–3.2 mm；蔗糖组的抑制更明显。
B【错】5 mM B 时，葡萄糖组花粉管仍约 2.8 mm，蔗糖组约 2.2 mm；抑制最明显的是蔗糖而非葡萄糖。
C【错】果糖组花粉管长度随 B 浓度升高而略增（约 2.7→3.2 mm），并未出现抑制增强。
D【对】糖-硼复合物形成会释放 H+、降低 pH；表 1 中 pH 下降幅度为蔗糖（5.2→4.9）< 葡萄糖（5.2→4.3）< 果糖（5.0→3.4），说明复合物形成量依次增多。

questions.question: Nitrogen is an important nutrient for all plants. While there is an abundance of nitrogen (N2) in the atmosphere, most plants are unable to convert N2 into a usable form. Fixation of nitrogen gas into ammonia is an ability restricted to nitrogen-fixing bacteria. The figure below shows a prerequisite step for nitrogen fixation through symbiosis between these bacteria and some plant species.
questions.question_zh: 氮是所有植物的重要营养元素。大气中虽有大量氮气（N2），但大多数植物无法将 N2 转化为可利用形式。将氮气固定为氨的能力仅限于固氮细菌。下图展示这些细菌与某些植物建立共生以实现固氮的先决步骤。

images.caption: Recognition, calcium spike, infection and nodule formation during rhizobium–legume symbiosis.
images.caption_zh: 根瘤菌—豆科植物共生过程中的识别、钙信号、侵染与根瘤形成。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: Between two major inorganic nitrogen forms, NH4+ and NO3−, the former is mobile in the plant, while the latter is not.
subQuestions.text_zh: 在两种主要无机氮形式 NH4+ 与 NO3− 中，前者在植物体内可移动，而后者不可移动。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Immediately after recognition of plant by bacteria and recognition of bacteria by host plant, a calcium spike occurs in the root cells.
subQuestions.text_zh: 在细菌识别植物、宿主植物识别细菌之后，根细胞立即出现钙峰。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: The plant hormone cytokinin is needed for initiation of nodule formation.
subQuestions.text_zh: 植物激素细胞分裂素是启动根瘤形成所必需的。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: Release of bacterial exopolysaccharides is the necessary and sufficient condition for a functional symbiosis between rhizobia and its appropriate host.
subQuestions.text_zh: 细菌释放胞外多糖是根瘤菌与其适宜宿主建立功能性共生的必要且充分条件。

questions.explanation:
A【错】NO3− 在植物体内可随蒸腾流长距离运输，是主要的可移动氮形式；NH4+ 同化快、移动性较差，且高浓度有毒性。
B【错】钙信号（钙峰/钙振荡）出现在 Nod 因子被受体识别之后，是信号转导的后续事件，并非“识别后立即”发生；图也显示识别、钙信号、侵染是先后步骤。
C【对】根瘤形成需要细胞分裂素促进皮层细胞分裂，细胞分裂素信号是根瘤原基启动的关键。
D【错】胞外多糖参与识别与侵染线形成，是共生建立的重要条件，但并非充分条件；还需要 Nod 因子、结瘤素、宿主遗传背景等多种因素协同。

questions.question:
Arabidopsis thaliana was used in a study on photosynthesis. A. thaliana plants of the same age, with leaf blades of equal shape and size, were placed under various light sources that emitted different colours. Three plants were exposed to each light source. The groupings were as follows:

Group a: blue light
Group b: green light
Group c: red light
Group d: blue and red
Group e: yellow and green

After 5 days of illumination at equal intensity comparable to normal daylight, in terms of total amount of photons and duration, the plants’ physiological parameters were compared. The compensation point was measured using sunlight.
questions.question_zh:
一项光合作用研究以拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）为材料。将年龄相同、叶片形状和大小一致的拟南芥植株置于发出不同颜色光的光源下。每种光源处理 3 株植物，分组如下：

a 组：蓝光
b 组：绿光
c 组：红光
d 组：蓝光 + 红光
e 组：黄光 + 绿光

在总光子数和照射时长相同、强度与正常日光相当的条件下照射 5 天后，比较植株的生理参数。光补偿点用阳光测定。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: The plants of group “a” showed the highest photosynthesis rate.
subQuestions.text_zh: a 组植株的光合速率最高。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Among the various groups, the light compensation point for CO2 fixation was the lowest for group “b”.
subQuestions.text_zh: 在各组中，b 组固定 CO2 的光补偿点最低。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: The biomass of group “d” plants was higher than group “c” plants.
subQuestions.text_zh: d 组植株的生物量高于 c 组植株。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: At light intensities just above the compensation point, the rate of photosynthesis of group “e” is expected to increase linearly with light.
subQuestions.text_zh: 在略高于补偿点的光强下，e 组的光合速率预计随光强线性增加。

questions.explanation:
A【错】红光和蓝光是叶绿素吸收峰，红光（c 组）及蓝+红光（d 组）的光合速率应高于单蓝光（a 组）；a 组不是最高。
B【对】绿光（b 组）被叶绿素吸收最少，植物通过调整光捕获色素，在低光下即可达到光合与呼吸相等的补偿点，因此其光补偿点最低。
C【对】蓝光 + 红光（d 组）同时覆盖两个吸收峰，光合产物积累多于单红光（c 组），生物量更高。
D【对】黄光 + 绿光（e 组）吸收效率低，在略高于补偿点的光强范围内仍处于光限制阶段，光合速率随光强近似线性增加。

questions.question: Some flowering plants are aquatic and have adapted to live in aquatic environments. They are divided into 3 types, depending on how much of the plant is normally positioned inside or outside of the water. These groups include emergent, floating, and submerged plants. The organs of submerged aquatic plants grow completely under water.
questions.question_zh: 有些被子植物是水生的，已适应水生环境。根据植株通常位于水中或水外的比例，可将其分为 3 类：挺水植物、浮水植物和沉水植物。沉水植物的器官完全在水中生长。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: They do not have xylem as they can absorb water from all of their surfaces.
subQuestions.text_zh: 它们没有木质部，因为可以从所有表面吸收水分。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Given that some species do have stomata, their opening and closing of the stomata is not expected to be driven by circadian rhythm.
subQuestions.text_zh: 鉴于某些物种确实有气孔，其气孔的开放与关闭预计不受昼夜节律驱动。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: These plants are heterophyllous, with thin and dark green leaves.
subQuestions.text_zh: 这些植物是异叶的，叶片薄且呈深绿色。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: These plants have a well-developed supporting mechanical tissues with thick walls.
subQuestions.text_zh: 这些植物具有发达的厚壁支持组织。

questions.explanation:
A【错】沉水植物并非完全没有木质部，而是木质部高度退化（仅保留少量管胞/导管）；它们确实可从体表吸水，但不能据此说完全没有木质部。
B【对】沉水植物即使有气孔（通常位于浮水叶或挺水部分），其开闭主要受水分状态与 CO2 等环境因素影响，而非典型的昼夜节律驱动。
C【错】沉水植物不一定异叶；其叶片通常薄、透明或浅绿色，以减少光吸收阻力，而不是“薄且深绿色”。
D【错】沉水植物生活在浮力支持的水中，机械组织（厚壁组织）高度退化，而不是发达。

questions.question: An important question in the evolution of angiosperms is the influence of life form and habit on speciation and extinction. In a phylogenetic study of the morphologically highly diverse plant order Saxifragales, the effect of habit and life history on speciation and extinction was investigated. Figures A–F illustrate estimates of speciation (λ) and extinction (μ) rates in annual, perennial, herbaceous, and woody lineages (Soltis et al., 2013). The results are given as posterior probability density, which reflects the uncertainty associated with parameter estimates. Dashed lines represent the median values of each distribution. Net diversification rate r = λ − μ.
questions.question_zh: 被子植物进化中的一个重要问题是生活型与习性对物种形成和灭绝的影响。在一项针对形态高度多样的虎耳草目（Saxifragales）的系统发育研究中，研究了习性与生活史对物种形成和灭绝的影响。图 A–F 展示了一年生的、多年生的、草本的与木本的谱系的物种形成率（λ）和灭绝率（μ）估计（Soltis 等，2013）。结果以后验概率密度表示，反映参数估计的不确定性。虚线表示各分布的中位数。净多样化速率 r = λ − μ。

images.caption: Posterior probability densities of speciation (top) and extinction (bottom) rates for annual vs perennial, woody vs herbaceous, and woody perennial / herbaceous perennial / herbaceous annual lineages.
images.caption_zh: 一年生与多年生、木本与草本、以及木本多年生/草本多年生/草本一年生谱系的物种形成率（上）与灭绝率（下）后验概率密度。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: Among different lineages, woody lineages have higher speciation (λ) and extinction (μ) rates.
subQuestions.text_zh: 在不同谱系中，木本谱系具有更高的物种形成率（λ）和灭绝率（μ）。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Results are consistent with the idea that shorter generation time causes higher speciation rate.
subQuestions.text_zh: 结果与“世代时间越短，物种形成率越高”的观点一致。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: As compared to the other groups, herbaceous perennial lineages have higher rates of net diversification.
subQuestions.text_zh: 与其他类群相比，草本多年生谱系具有更高的净多样化速率。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: Generation time and breeding systems affect rates of diversification.
subQuestions.text_zh: 世代时间与繁育系统会影响多样化速率。

questions.explanation:
A【错】图中木本谱系的物种形成率（λ）高于草本，但灭绝率（μ）低于草本；并非两者都更高。
B【错】一年生植物世代时间更短，但其物种形成率低于多年生植物；结果与“世代短→物种形成率高”相反。
C【错】草本多年生 λ≈0.17、μ≈0.12，r≈0.05；木本多年生 λ≈0.40、μ≈0.35，r≈0.05；二者净多样化速率相近，草本多年生并不更高。
D【对】不同生活史（一年生/多年生）与生长型（木本/草本）谱系的 λ、μ 存在系统差异，说明世代时间与繁育系统确实影响多样化速率。

questions.question: Phylogenetic relationship among several species of the genus Nemesia (Scrophulariaceae), accompanied with geological time scale, is shown below. Predicted states for annual/perennial life-history have been mapped to the tree. Annual life-history is shown in black and the perennials are shown in blue (from Datson et al., 2008).
questions.question_zh: 下图展示玄参科 Nemesia 属若干物种的系统发育关系及地质时间尺度。一年生/多年生生活史的预测状态已映射到树上：一年生为黑色，多年生为蓝色（引自 Datson 等，2008）。

images.caption: Phylogenetic tree of Nemesia with annual (black) and perennial (blue) life-history states. Diascia rigescens is the outgroup.
images.caption_zh: Nemesia 系统发育树，标注一年生（黑色）与多年生（蓝色）生活史状态。Diascia rigescens 为外群。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: The phylogenetic tree suggests that Nemesia originated during the Miocene, but the majority of extant Nemesia species radiated during the Pliocene (Pl.) and Quaternary (Qu.).
subQuestions.text_zh: 该树提示 Nemesia 起源于中新世，但现存 Nemesia 物种的多数在上新世（Pl.）和第四纪（Qu.）发生辐射。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: The phylogenetic tree suggests that the most recent common ancestor of Nemesia had an annual life form.
subQuestions.text_zh: 该树提示 Nemesia 的最近共同祖先是一年生生活型。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: The phylogenetic tree does not show shift from annual to perennial habit.
subQuestions.text_zh: 该树未显示从一年生向多年生习性的转变。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: Diascia rigescens is the ancestral species of all other taxa in this phylogenetic tree.
subQuestions.text_zh: Diascia rigescens 是该系统发育树中所有其它分类单元的祖先种。

questions.explanation:
A【错】树中 Nemesia 的基部分歧约在 25–30 Ma（渐新世/中新世早期），多数现存谱系在中新世（约 5–15 Ma）已经分化；并非多数在上新世和第四纪才辐射。
B【错】树基部与大多数早期分支为蓝色（多年生），说明最近共同祖先为多年生，而不是一年生。
C【对】树中黑色（一年生）分支嵌套在蓝色（多年生）分支内，显示多年生→一年生的转变，没有支持一年生→多年生的转变。
D【错】Diascia rigescens 位于树的最外侧，是外群（用于根系），不是所有 Nemesia 分类单元的祖先种。

questions.question:
Correlation between genome size in polyploid and diploid lineages and life history and occupation of alpine habitat for the genus Veronica (Plantaginaceae) was investigated (Meudt et al., 2015). The genus primarily originated in the northern hemisphere. The phylogenetic tree below includes variables of interest including:

• 1C-value (amount of DNA contained in a haploid genome)
• life history (annual: bar; perennial: no bar)
• habitat (non-alpine: no bar; alpine: bar)
• ploidy (2× to 18×)
questions.question_zh:
研究调查了车前科 Veronica 属多倍体与二倍体谱系的基因组大小、生活史以及是否占据高山生境之间的相关性（Meudt 等，2015）。该属主要起源于北半球。下图的系统发育树包含以下关注变量：

• 1C 值（单倍体基因组所含 DNA 量）
• 生活史（一年生：有横条；多年生：无横条）
• 生境（非高山：无横条；高山：有横条）
• 倍性（2× 至 18×）

images.caption: Phylogenetic tree of Veronica showing 1C-value, life history, alpine habitat and ploidy for each lineage.
images.caption_zh: Veronica 系统发育树，显示各谱系的 1C 值、生活史、高山生境与倍性。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: All the Southern hemisphere species are polyploid.
subQuestions.text_zh: 所有南半球物种都是多倍体。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Polyploidy is always accompanied by genomic upsizing.
subQuestions.text_zh: 多倍化总是伴随基因组增大。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: Transitions from annual to perennial life history can be accompanied by migration to the higher elevations or cooler climates.
subQuestions.text_zh: 从一年生向多年生生活史的转变可能伴随向高海拔或更凉爽气候的迁移。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: Annual species are never found in alpine habitats.
subQuestions.text_zh: 一年生物种从不出现在高山生境中。

questions.explanation:
A【对】树中标注的南半球物种分支倍性均为 5×–15× 甚至更高，全部为多倍体。
B【错】图中部分高倍性谱系的 1C 值并不比低倍性谱系大，说明多倍化后可能伴随基因组缩减（DNA 丢失），并非总是增大。
C【对】树中多年生分支与高山生境横条、较高海拔/凉爽气候的分布相对应，说明生活史转变可与生境迁移耦合。
D【对】图中一年生横条与高山生境横条在同一分支上互斥，未出现一年生 + 高山的组合。

questions.question:
Chloroplast symbiosis or kleptoplasty refers to a naturally occurring process that results in maintenance of chloroplasts of one species in host cells of another species. This process has occurred in sacoglossan sea slugs (Figure 1: Pierce and Curtis, 2012). Cells that line the digestive diverticula of the slugs maintain chloroplasts that originated from algal food. Sea slug species with these chloroplasts are able to tolerate starvation for periods up to one year. It has been shown that some sea slugs are able to retain functional plastids for a year or more, or even to the end of their life.

Several hypotheses were tested to find the mechanisms behind this kind of symbiosis. All earlier attempts to locate algal nuclei in such sea slugs failed. However, recent studies have demonstrated presence of Vaucheria litorea algal nuclear genes in genomic DNA of the larvae of the slug Elysia chlorotica which have never fed on V. litorea. Note that use of animal proteins by chloroplasts seems implausible.
questions.question_zh:
叶绿体共生或“盗质体”（kleptoplasty）是指一种自然发生的过程：一个物种的叶绿体在另一物种的宿主细胞中被维持。这一过程见于囊舌目海蛞蝓（图 1：Pierce 与 Curtis，2012）。海蛞蝓消化盲囊内壁的细胞可维持来源于藻类食物的叶绿体。带有这些叶绿体的海蛞蝓能耐受长达一年的饥饿。已有研究表明，某些海蛞蝓能将功能性质体保留一年以上，甚至保留到生命结束。

为寻找这种共生背后的机制，研究者检验了若干假说。早期所有在这类海蛞蝓中定位藻类细胞核的尝试均告失败。然而，近期研究在从未取食 Vaucheria litorea 的海蛞蝓 Elysia chlorotica 幼虫的基因组 DNA 中检测到了 V. litorea 的藻类核基因。注意：叶绿体利用动物蛋白似乎不太可能。

images.caption: Sacoglossan sea slugs: A, Elysia chlorotica; B, Elysia clarki.
images.caption_zh: 囊舌目海蛞蝓：A，Elysia chlorotica；B，Elysia clarki。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: Horizontal gene transfer might have resulted in transfer of certain genes of the harvested chloroplast into the genome of some slugs, particularly in slugs that have maintained chloroplasts for long periods of time.
subQuestions.text_zh: 水平基因转移可能使被获取的叶绿体的某些基因转移到某些海蛞蝓的基因组中，尤其是在长期维持叶绿体的海蛞蝓中。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Activity of lysosomal enzymes in host cells must be minimal in order to prevent chloroplast ingestion.
subQuestions.text_zh: 为防止叶绿体被摄入，宿主细胞中溶酶体酶的活性必须很低。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: The sea slugs with algal chloroplasts also need algal mitochondria to ensure a source of energy during periods of starvation.
subQuestions.text_zh: 带有藻类叶绿体的海蛞蝓还需要藻类线粒体，以保证饥饿期间的能量来源。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: Nuclear algal RNA present in ingested chloroplasts could somehow persist for as long as one year in the sea slug.
subQuestions.text_zh: 被摄入叶绿体中的藻类核 RNA 能够以某种方式在海蛞蝓体内存留长达一年。

questions.explanation:
A【对】在海蛞蝓基因组中检测到藻类核基因，说明长期维持叶绿体的物种可能通过水平基因转移获得部分藻类基因，以支持质体功能。
B【错】溶酶体酶活性低有利于避免消化叶绿体，但“防止叶绿体被摄入”不是溶酶体酶的功能；溶酶体作用于已摄入的细胞器，且该说法把因果关系弄反了。
C【错】叶绿体本身进行光合作用产生 ATP 与有机物，饥饿期间海蛞蝓依赖的是叶绿体的光合产物；没有证据表明还需要藻类线粒体。
D【错】叶绿体不含细胞核，藻类核 RNA 不会存在于被摄入的叶绿体中；且核 RNA 半衰期短，不可能在宿主内存留一年。

questions.question: The following figure shows two histological sections of an organ from an angiosperm plant. The tissue section on the left was prepared from the medial part of the organ, whereas the section on the right was from the lateral part.
questions.question_zh: 下图展示某种被子植物器官的两张组织切片。左侧切片取自该器官的中部，右侧切片取自侧部。

images.caption: Histological sections from the medial (left) and lateral (right) parts of an angiosperm organ.
images.caption_zh: 被子植物器官中部（左）与侧部（右）的组织切片。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: The sections were prepared from a monocotyledonous plant.
subQuestions.text_zh: 这些切片取自单子叶植物。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: The sections represent a modified stem.
subQuestions.text_zh: 这些切片代表一个变态茎。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: Transpiration occurs in this organ.
subQuestions.text_zh: 该器官中进行蒸腾作用。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: The vascular bundles are of bicolateral type, meaning that phloem is present on both sides of xylem.
subQuestions.text_zh: 维管束为双韧型，即木质部两侧均有韧皮部。

questions.explanation:
A【错】左图显示明显的栅栏组织与海绵组织分化、气孔下陷等叶片结构，是双子叶植物叶片的特征；单子叶叶片通常无这种明显的栅栏/海绵分化。
B【错】切片具有表皮、叶肉（栅栏组织与海绵组织）和叶脉维管束，是叶片结构，不是变态茎。
C【对】叶片是蒸腾作用的主要器官，气孔分布其中，水分经气孔散失。
D【错】图中维管束为外韧型（木质部在内、韧皮部在外），并非双韧型（韧皮部位于木质部两侧）。

questions.question:
Bighorn sheep (Ovis canadensis), the males of which are famous for their magnificent curl of horns, live in North America. Their hunting was restricted in 1970. This restriction made trophy rams (males with large and fully-curved horns) extremely valuable, sometimes costing over $100,000 to be hunted. Funds raised in this way were used for preserving bighorn habitats.

Coltman and his colleagues (2003) showed that there is a relationship between year and decrease of mean mass and mean horn length of bighorn sheep in Alberta, Canada, where trophy hunting was conducted over 30 years.
questions.question_zh:
大角羊（Ovis canadensis）生活在北美，雄性以雄伟的卷角闻名。1970 年起其狩猎受到限制；这一限制使“战利品公羊”（角大且完全卷曲的雄性）变得极其昂贵，狩猎费用有时超过 10 万美元。所得资金用于保护大角羊栖息地。

Coltman 及其同事（2003）发现，在加拿大艾伯塔省，大角羊的平均体重和平均角长随年份下降，该地区进行了 30 年的战利品狩猎。

images.caption: Decline in average horn length (top) and average body mass (bottom) of bighorn sheep in Alberta from 1970 to 2000.
images.caption_zh: 1970–2000 年艾伯塔省大角羊平均角长（上）与平均体重（下）的下降趋势。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: The observed changes in the mean mass and horn length imply a reduction in the bighorn sheep population.
subQuestions.text_zh: 观察到的平均体重与角长变化意味着大角羊种群数量减少。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Phenotype-based selective harvest can change population characters if it targets heritable traits.
subQuestions.text_zh: 如果针对可遗传性状，基于表型的选择性收获可以改变种群特征。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: If variation in horn size is mainly due to additive genetic interactions, the heritability (the portion of the phenotypic variance explained by genotype variance) for this trait would decrease over time.
subQuestions.text_zh: 如果角大小的变异主要来自加性遗传效应，那么该性状的遗传力（表型方差中由基因型方差解释的部分）会随时间下降。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: By hunting males with longest horns, the variance in the reproductive success of the males increases.
subQuestions.text_zh: 猎杀角最长的雄性会增加雄性繁殖成功的方差。

subQuestions.label: E
subQuestions.text: The trends establish genetic correlation between horn length and mass.
subQuestions.text_zh: 这些趋势确立了角长与体重之间的遗传相关。

questions.explanation:
A【错】平均体重和角长下降反映的是表型/遗传组成的变化（选择性狩猎的进化后果），并不能推断种群数量减少。
B【对】若被选择的性状可遗传，基于表型的定向选择会改变种群的性状分布，这正是战利品狩猎导致角长和体重下降的机制。
C【对】持续的定向选择会消耗加性遗传方差，使遗传力随时间下降，选择反应逐渐减弱。
D【错】猎杀角最长的雄性会减少少数大角雄性的繁殖机会，使更多雄性参与繁殖，从而降低而非增加雄性繁殖成功方差。
E【错】两个性状同步下降只说明表型相关或选择同时作用于两者，不能据此确立遗传相关；需要遗传参数估计才能判断。

questions.question:
J. B. S. Haldane (1892–1964), one of the founders of modern evolutionary biology, stated that if among hybrid offspring one sex is absent, rare, or sterile, that sex is the heterogametic one, i.e., in an X-Y sex-determination system, XY hybrids are preferentially sterile or inviable. Presgraves and Orr (1998) decided to test Haldane’s rule on taxa lacking a hemizygous X.

They focused on mosquitoes from the genera Aedes and Anopheles. In Aedes, males are XY and females are XX, but both X and Y chromosomes carry complete sets of homologous genes, while in Anopheles Y chromosomes are degenerate. They compiled the available data on the sterility of the hybrids resulting from crossing pairs of species in these taxa (tables below).

Hint: Assume each character is controlled by many loci.
questions.question_zh:
现代进化生物学奠基人之一 J. B. S. Haldane（1892–1964）提出：如果杂种后代中某一性别缺失、稀少或不育，那么该性别就是异配性别；即在 X-Y 性别决定系统中，XY 杂种优先表现为不育或不能存活。Presgraves 与 Orr（1998）决定在缺乏半合子 X 的类群中检验 Haldane 规则。

他们聚焦于伊蚊属（Aedes）和按蚊属（Anopheles）。在伊蚊中，雄性为 XY、雌性为 XX，但 X 和 Y 染色体都携带完整的同源基因；而在按蚊中，Y 染色体已退化。他们整理了这些类群种间杂交所得杂种不育性的现有数据（下表）。

提示：假设每个性状由许多位点控制。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: If the males in genus Anopheles were under strong selection, we would expect the same pattern of hybrid sterility as presented here.
subQuestions.text_zh: 如果按蚊属的雄性受到强选择，我们预计会出现与这里所示相同的杂种不育模式。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: The hybrid sterility patterns observed in both genera are consistent with the idea that alleles involved in hybrid sterility are recessive.
subQuestions.text_zh: 两个属中观察到的杂种不育模式与“参与杂种不育的等位基因是隐性的”这一观点一致。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: If the pattern of sterility in Aedes were identical to that of Anopheles, it would disprove Haldane’s rule.
subQuestions.text_zh: 如果伊蚊的不育模式与按蚊完全相同，就会推翻 Haldane 规则。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: The pattern of hybrid sterility in Aedes suggest variation in Y chromosome functionality in this genus.
subQuestions.text_zh: 伊蚊的杂种不育模式提示该属内 Y 染色体功能存在变异。

questions.explanation:
A【对】按蚊雄性为 XY（异配性别），Y 染色体退化；若雄性受到强选择，与雄性育性相关的基因会在性染色体上积累，杂种雄性仍会优先出现不育，模式与表中一致。
B【错】若不育等位基因完全隐性，F1 杂合子不应表现不育；观察到雄性不育说明相关等位基因在雄性中呈显性或半显性，或受性别特异调控，因此该说法不一致。
C【错】Haldane 规则描述的是“杂种中异配性别优先不育/不存活”的现象；即使两个属模式相同，也只是说明机制相似，不能推翻规则。
D【对】伊蚊 X、Y 均携带完整同源基因，但部分杂交仅雄性不育、部分两性均不育，说明不同物种的 Y 染色体功能存在差异，影响杂种育性。

questions.question:
Bustamante et al. (2005) analysed the pattern of polymorphism in the human genome by sequencing over 11,624 genes from 39 humans. The table below shows the distributions of synonymous (changes that do not result in amino acid replacement) and non-synonymous (changes that result in amino acid replacement) single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs – variation within species):

In the table, divergence refers to the fixed differences between the humans in this study and the chimpanzee genome.
questions.question_zh:
Bustamante 等（2005）对 39 名人类的 11,624 个以上基因进行测序，分析了人类基因组的多态性模式。下表显示同义（不导致氨基酸替换的变异）与非同义（导致氨基酸替换的变异）单核苷酸多态性（SNP，即种内变异）的分布：

表中“分化”指本研究中人类与黑猩猩基因组之间的固定差异。

head: Divergence
SNPs

tables_zh.title: 同义与非同义 SNP 及分化位点的分布
head: 分化

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: Greater ratio of non-synonymous to synonymous SNPs relative to ratio of non-synonymous to synonymous divergent sites suggest the effect of negative selection in human.
subQuestions.text_zh: 非同义/同义 SNP 的比值高于非同义/同义分化位点的比值，提示人类受到负选择的作用。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: The ratio of synonymous/non-synonymous SNPs is higher in genes involved in chromatin structure.
subQuestions.text_zh: 在染色质结构相关基因中，同义/非同义 SNP 的比值更高。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: Arms races caused by host-specific pathogens would decrease the ratio of synonymous/non-synonymous substitutions in divergent sites between human and chimpanzee.
subQuestions.text_zh: 宿主特异性病原体引起的“军备竞赛”会降低人类与黑猩猩分化位点中同义/非同义替换的比值。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: SNPs present within chimpanzee population cannot result in any level of reproductive isolation in chimpanzee population.
subQuestions.text_zh: 黑猩猩种群内存在的 SNP 不可能导致该种群出现任何程度的生殖隔离。

questions.explanation:
A【错】非同义/同义 SNP 比值高于分化位点比值，说明非同义变异在种内被保留得较多，提示放松的负选择或正选择，而不是负选择增强；负选择会降低非同义 SNP 比例。
B【对】染色质结构基因功能高度保守，非同义突变多被负选择清除，因此同义/非同义 SNP 比值较高。
C【对】与宿主特异性病原体的军备竞赛会驱动免疫/防御基因发生适应性非同义替换，使分化位点中非同义替换增多，同义/非同义比值下降。
D【错】种群内 SNP 若影响交配偏好、杂交适合度或生态适应，可能逐步导致生殖隔离；不能断言“任何程度都不可能”。

questions.question: The evolution of sexual reproduction has remained in certain aspects a puzzle which is yet to be fully pieced back together. Over the years many hypotheses have been proposed to explain this phenomenon.
questions.question_zh: 有性生殖的进化在某些方面仍是一个尚未完全解开的谜题。多年来，人们提出了许多假说来解释这一现象。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: The effect of sexual reproduction on the association between alleles is expected to improve the fitness of co-adapted genes.
subQuestions.text_zh: 有性生殖对等位基因之间关联的影响，预计会提高共适应基因组合的适合度。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Given that the majority of mutations are deleterious, sex is expected to counter the loss of mutation-free individuals in small populations.
subQuestions.text_zh: 鉴于大多数突变是有害的，有性生殖预计能对抗小种群中无突变个体的丧失。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: Avoiding inbreeding in sexually-reproducing organisms is expected to be advantageous when deleterious mutations are co-dominant.
subQuestions.text_zh: 当有害突变为共显性时，有性生殖生物避免近交预计具有优势。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: One would expect a greater proportion of sexually reproducing species in stable regions, as compared to unstable regions.
subQuestions.text_zh: 与不稳定地区相比，稳定地区预计有更高比例的有性生殖物种。

questions.explanation:
A【错】有性生殖通过重组打散等位基因组合，可能破坏共适应的基因组合，产生重组负荷；它并不必然提高共适应基因的适合度。
B【对】小种群中无突变个体易因遗传漂变和穆勒棘轮而丢失；有性生殖通过重组重新组合无突变基因，能减缓这一过程。
C【错】近交衰退主要由隐性有害等位基因纯合化引起；若有害突变为共显性，杂合子已表现有害效应，避免近交的额外优势反而减弱。
D【错】“红皇后”假说认为有性生殖在生物环境不稳定、病原体/竞争者快速变化的地区更有优势，因此稳定地区有性物种比例不应更高。

questions.question:
According to evolutionary concepts, symbiosis is a general characteristic of living organisms and can help to understand complex features and phenotypes. Gut microbiota and host evolve in symbiosis and have developed an integrative circuitry essential for their survival. This complex relationship resulted in a personal evolutionary adapted ecosystem. Recently developed genomics and metagenomics approaches helped to discover the link between gut microbiota alteration and host health and disease.

Gagnière and his colleagues (2016) highlighted the unexpected role of human gut microbiota in colorectal cancer. More recently, in a study conducted by Flemer and his colleagues (2018), it has been emphasized that the heterogeneity of colorectal cancer might be related to the types of gut microbiota that either predispose or offer resistance to the disease.

Boxplots show the relative abundances of three bacterial groups from individuals with colorectal cancer (CRC), individuals with polyps (the intermediate stage between healthy and cancerous tissue which does not always turn into CRC) and healthy controls (HC). An asterisk represents a significant p value: ***p < 0.001; **p < 0.01; *p < 0.05; p > 0.05.
questions.question_zh:
按照进化概念，共生是生物界的普遍特征，有助于理解复杂的特征与表型。肠道菌群与宿主在共生中共同进化，形成了对其生存至关重要的整合网络。这种复杂关系造就了各自进化适应的生态系统。近年发展的基因组学与宏基因组学方法，有助于揭示肠道菌群改变与宿主健康、疾病之间的联系。

Gagnière 等（2016）强调了人类肠道菌群在结直肠癌中的意外作用。更近期，Flemer 等（2018）的研究强调，结直肠癌的异质性可能与肠道菌群类型有关：某些菌群易感，某些则提供抵抗。

箱线图显示结直肠癌（CRC）患者、息肉患者（健康组织与癌组织之间的中间阶段，并不总会发展为 CRC）和健康对照（HC）中三个细菌类群的相对丰度。星号表示显著的 p 值：***p < 0.001；**p < 0.01；*p < 0.05；p > 0.05。

images.caption: Relative abundances of bacterial groups 1, 2 and 3 in healthy controls (green), polyp patients (blue) and CRC patients (red).
images.caption_zh: 健康对照（绿色）、息肉患者（蓝色）与 CRC 患者（红色）中细菌类群 1、2、3 的相对丰度。

subQuestions.label: A
subQuestions.text: The microbiota compositional differences between patients with CRC and the control are secondary to the onset of cancer.
subQuestions.text_zh: CRC 患者与对照之间的菌群组成差异是癌症发生后的继发结果。

subQuestions.label: B
subQuestions.text: Changes in the abundance of the bacteria group 2 compared to the control are restricted to polyp.
subQuestions.text_zh: 与对照相比，细菌类群 2 丰度的变化仅局限于息肉患者。

subQuestions.label: C
subQuestions.text: Any bacterial group that populates the gut is in association with an increased risk of CRC.
subQuestions.text_zh: 任何定植于肠道的细菌类群都与 CRC 风险增加相关。

subQuestions.label: D
subQuestions.text: The polyp-associated microbiota can be used as an indicator for individuals with higher risk of developing CRC.
subQuestions.text_zh: 息肉相关菌群可作为 CRC 高风险个体的指标。

questions.explanation:
A【错】息肉阶段（癌前病变）已出现菌群改变，说明菌群差异可能先于癌症发生并参与致病，而不是癌症发生后的继发结果。
B【错】图中类群 2 在 CRC 和息肉组均与对照有显著差异，并非仅局限于息肉。
C【错】类群 3 在 CRC 和息肉患者中相对丰度降低，属于与风险增加相关的“保护性”变化，不能一概说任何菌群都增加风险。
D【对】息肉阶段已出现特征性菌群改变，可作为 CRC 高风险个体的早期指示。
